sections.title: Monitoring Financial Inventory Values Apps
sections.en: 7.5.4 Monitoring Financial Inventory Values Apps The monetary value tied up in physical stocks in your facility is a key metric by which inventory managers are measured. Therefore, SAP S/4HANA provides several standard reports to help monitor financial inventory values and to manage and control inven- tory values. In addition, the following apps can be used to monitor the financial inventory values in the system:  Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary  Material Inventory Values—Line Items We’ll discuss these apps in the following sections. Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary Use the Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary app (see Figure 7.45) to under- stand the quantities and values of your material inventories on a specific date, which can be current or in the past. Figure 7.45 Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary App The Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary app allows you to do the following:  View inventory values and quantities sorted by company code, general ledger account, material group, material, business transaction type, posting date, and doc- ument number.  Analyze line items in detail with a wide number of attributes (plant, material) and key figures (inventory quantity, inventory amount in up to three currencies. 7 Inventory Management 294  Filter and analyze inventories using dimensions such as general ledger account, material, profit center, and fiscal year.  Show the analysis of the line items using graphics, tables, or a combination of both. The Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary app is assigned to the inventory manager standard authorization role. Material Inventory Values—Line Items The Material Inventory Values—Line Items app (see Figure 7.46) is used to understand quantities and values of your material inventories at the line item level. Figure 7.46 Material Inventory Values—Line Items App This app displays the following information about material inventory values:  The inventory value and quantity of the journal entries that affect the value of mate- rial inventories during a particular period  The date of the source document, the proposed posting date, and the actual posting date The Material Inventory Values—Line Items app allows you to do the following:  View inventory values and quantities sorted by company code, general ledger account, material group, material, business transaction type, posting date, and doc- ument number.  Analyze line items in detail with a wide number of attributes (plant, material) and key figures (inventory quantity, inventory amount in up to three currencies). © 295 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management  Filter and analyze inventories using dimensions such as general ledger account, material, profit center, and fiscal year.  Show the analysis of line items using graphics, tables, or a combination of both. The Material Inventory Values—Line Items app is assigned to the inventory manager standard authorization role.
sections.he:
הערך הכספי הקשור במלאי הוא מדד מפתח. ‏S/4HANA מספק דוחות לניטור ערכי מלאי. אפליקציות:
• Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary
• Material Inventory Values—Line Items

**Material Inventory Values—Balance Summary** (Figure 7.45) — כמויות וערכים בתאריך (נוכחי/עבר). מאפשר:
• הצגת ערכים וכמויות לפי company code, ‏GL account, ‏material group, ‏material, ‏business transaction type, ‏posting date, ‏document number.
• ניתוח line items עם attributes (plant, ‏material) ו-key figures (כמות, סכום עד שלושה מטבעות).
• סינון לפי GL account, ‏material, ‏profit center, ‏fiscal year.
• ניתוח בגרפיקה/טבלה.
מוקצה ל-inventory manager.

**Material Inventory Values—Line Items** (Figure 7.46) — כמויות וערכים ברמת ה-line item. מציג:
• ערך וכמות של ה-journal entries המשפיעים על ערך המלאי בתקופה.
• תאריך מסמך המקור, ‏posting date מוצע, ובפועל.
מאפשר אותן יכולות (תצוגה לפי company code/GL/material וכו', ניתוח, סינון, גרפיקה). מוקצה ל-inventory manager.

צמד-האפליקציות הזה הוא הגשר בין עולם-הכמויות לעולם-הכספים, והוא משרת את המדד שמנהלי-מלאי נמדדים בו באמת — הערך הכלוא: ‏Balance Summary נותן את התמונה המצרפית לתאריך — נוכחי או היסטורי — עם חיתוכים לפי company code, חשבון-GL, קבוצת-חומר, חומר וסוג-עסקה, ניתוח line items עם עד שלושה מטבעות, וסינון לפי profit center ושנת-כספים; ו-Line Items יורד לרזולוציית התנועה הבודדת — כל journal entry שהשפיע על ערך-המלאי בתקופה, עם תאריכי המקור והרישום. השילוב ביניהן הוא מתודולוגיית-העבודה: ה-Summary מגלה את החריגה (קבוצת-חומר שערכה זינק), וה-Line Items חושף את מקורה (התנועות שבנו את הזינוק). שני שימושים שוטפים שכדאי למסד: ההתאמה החודשית מול הכספים — ערכי-המלאי כאן מול יתרות ה-GL, כשכל פער הוא דגל — והמעקב אחר התפלגות-הערך לפי סטטוס (כמה כסף יושב בחסום? בבדיקת-איכות?) שהוא מדד-בריאות תפעולי במסווה פיננסי. ההקצאה ל-inventory manager טבעית — אך שווה לשתף את המסכים הללו גם עם החשב: שפה משותפת חוסכת ויכוחי-סוף-חודש.

**הערת יועץ:** הגשר לכספים: ‏Balance Summary (מצרפי לתאריך — גם עבר! — לפי code/GL/קבוצה/חומר, עד שלושה מטבעות) + ‏Line Items ‏(journal entries שהשפיעו על הערך). מנקודת-מבט מעשית, שני שימושים ממוסדים: התאמה חודשית מול ה-GL (כל פער = דגל) והתפלגות-ערך לפי סטטוס (כמה כסף בחסום?). יועץ משתף את המסכים עם החשב — שפה משותפת חוסכת את ויכוחי סוף-החודש.

sections.title: Inventory Management Object Pages
sections.en: 7.5.5 Inventory Management Object Pages There are several inventory management object pages available in SAP S/4HANA:  Material Document  Material  Supplier  Customer  Inbound Delivery  Outbound Delivery We’ll discuss these object pages in the following sections. Material Document Object Page The Material Document object page (see Figure 7.47) displays useful information about the material document posted in the SAP S/4HANA system. Via this object page, you can navigate to related business objects and to transactional apps. Figure 7.47 Material Document: Object Page 7 Inventory Management 296 Here you can do the following:  Display an overview of material document header and line item data, such as move- ment type, document date, and materials transacted.  Obtain a graphical process flow of other business documents related to this material document (see Figure 7.48).  Navigate to additional information relevant to this material document, such as details for related business partners, related master data, or related documents. The Material Document object page is assigned to the inventory manager and ware- house clerk standard authorization roles. Figure 7.48 Material Document: Process Flow Material Object Page The Material object page (see Figure 7.49) is used to display an overview of a specific material. You navigate to this object page from other SAP Fiori apps, or you can navi- gate to additional information related to this material, such as detailed information about related master data or related documents. The Material object page can also show the following:  Suppliers of the material, using the purchasing view  Procurement master data and documents for the material (see Figure 7.50) The Material object page is assigned to the purchaser, warehouse manager, warehouse clerk, and accounts payable accountant standard authorization roles. © 297 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management Figure 7.49 Material Object Page Figure 7.50 Procurement Master Data and Documents for Material Supplier Object Page The Supplier object page (see Figure 7.51) is used to display an overview of a specific sup- plier. You navigate to this object page from other SAP Fiori apps, or you can navigate to 7 Inventory Management 298 additional information related to the individual supplier, such as detailed information about related business partners, related master data, or related documents. The Supplier object page can also show the following:  Company code data for the supplier  Communication and blocking data for the supplier  Materials provided to your company by the supplier  Annual spend for the supplier The Supplier object page is assigned to the buyer, accounts payable accountant, and many other standard authorization roles. Figure 7.51 Supplier Object Page Customer Object Page The Customer object page (see Figure 7.52) is used to display an overview of a specific customer. You navigate to this object page from other SAP Fiori apps, or you can navi- gate to additional information related to the individual customer, such as detailed infor- mation about related business partners, related master data, or related documents. The Customer object page can also show the following:  Company code and sales area data for the customer  Related sales orders and billing documents for the customer  Communication data and blocking data for the customer The Customer object page is assigned to the customer master specialist and accounts receivable accountant standard authorization roles. © 299 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management Figure 7.52 Customer Object Page Inbound Delivery Object Page Use the Inbound Delivery object page (see Figure 7.53) to display details about a specific inbound delivery document. You can also easily access related documents and master data related to this inbound delivery document, such as business partners. Figure 7.53 Inbound Delivery Object Page: General Information 7 Inventory Management 300 You can navigate to this app by searching for inbound deliveries from the Enterprise Search area of the SAP Fiori launchpad. You can search for inbound deliveries using key fields such as receiving point, material number, or supplier. The results are shown in a worklist from which you can easily retrieve details for each inbound delivery doc- ument listed. The Inbound Delivery object page can be used to do the following:  Display attributes of the inbound delivery document, such as receiving point, over- all status, and delivery date.  Display the materials to be received, along with quantity and receiving plant and storage location.  Display the contact details of the business partners involved in the inbound delivery.  Display the process flow, a graphical overview of the chain of connected process steps and corresponding business documents (see Figure 7.54). For example, you can view the purchase order that preceded the inbound delivery or the material docu- ment that recorded the goods receipt posting for the inbound delivery. The Inbound Delivery object page is assigned to the receiving specialist, inventory man- ager, and warehouse clerk standard authorization roles. Figure 7.54 Inbound Delivery Object Page: Process Flow © 301 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management Outbound Delivery Object Page Use the Outbound Delivery object page (see Figure 7.55) to display details about a spe- cific outbound delivery document. You can also easily access related documents and master data related to this outbound delivery document, such as business partners. Figure 7.55 Outbound Delivery Object Page: General Information You can navigate to this app by searching for outbound deliveries from the Enterprise Search area of the SAP Fiori launchpad. You can search for outbound deliveries using key fields such as shipping point, material number, or customer. The results are shown in a worklist from which you can easily retrieve details for each outbound delivery doc- ument listed. The Outbound Delivery object page can be used to do the following:  Display attributes of the outbound delivery document, such as shipping point, over- all status, and delivery date.  Display the materials to be shipped, along with quantity and shipping plant and storage location. 7 Inventory Management 302  Display the contact details of the business partners involved in the outbound deliv- ery.  Display the process flow, a graphical overview of the chain of connected process steps and corresponding business documents (see Figure 7.56). For example, you can view the sales order that preceded the outbound delivery or the material document that recorded the goods issue posting for the outbound delivery. The Outbound Delivery object page is assigned to the shipping specialist standard authorization role. Figure 7.56 Outbound Delivery Object Page: Process Flow

sections.title: Inventory Management Analytics
sections.en: 7.5.6 Inventory Management Analytics Managing the myriad stock items in a typical warehouse can be a daunting task. Ware- house personnel and inventory managers need information to understand how goods are moving into, within, and out of a facility. They also need to understand the velocity of materials so that materials that are moving slowly can be addressed to optimize stor- age space and placement within the warehouse. © 303 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management SAP S/4HANA supplies the following inventory management analytics apps for use by inventory managers:  Goods Movement Analysis  Inventory Turnover Analysis  Slow or Non-Moving Materials  Dead Stock Analysis  Inventory KPI Analysis We’ll discuss each app in the following sections. Goods Movement Analysis The Goods Movement Analysis app (see Figure 7.57) allows you to investigate goods movements in your enterprise. The Goods Movement Analysis app has the following features:  Define filters to narrow your search scope, such as plant, material, and material group.  Choose from a variety of dimensions for analysis, such as plant, storage location, material, year/month, calendar week, and day of year.  Choose from a variety of key figures, such as stock change quantity, stock change amount, consumption quantity, consumption amount, movement count, issue count, and receipt count.  Drill down to an individual material document item if required. Figure 7.57 Goods Movement Analysis App 7 Inventory Management 304  Sorting, totaling, and subtotaling.  Export to a spreadsheet. The Goods Movement Analysis app is assigned to the inventory manager standard authorization role. Inventory Turnover Analysis The Inventory Turnover Analysis app (see Figure 7.58) assists you in monitoring the turnover of material in a plant. Turnover is defined as the relation between goods issue quantities and stock quantities within a set time period. This app provides detailed information on materials that have turnover issues based on a specified time horizon. The Inventory Turnover Analysis app lets you do the fol- lowing:  Perform research on turnover-related issues down to individual materials.  Display detailed turnover analysis results using different representations—for example, as a scatter or bubble chart.  See the stock value of materials with turnover issues; stock value calculation is based on stock quantity of the selected reporting date multiplied by the current material price. The Inventory Turnover Analysis app is assigned to the inventory manager standard authorization role. Figure 7.58 Inventory Turnover Analysis App © 305 7.5 Reporting in Inventory Management Slow or Non-Moving Materials Use the Slow or Non-Moving Materials app (see Figure 7.59) to monitor and investigate those materials for which the velocity through the warehouse is slower than normal. Based on this, you can then initiate follow-on actions, such as scrapping or rearrange- ment in the facility. The Slow or Non-Moving Materials app has the following features:  Allows monitoring of slow-moving materials.  Monitors how much working capital is tied up by the slow-moving items.  Execution of follow-up activities based on the analysis results.  Predictive model for the slow-moving indicator for a material in a time period to see if a material may deviate from the previous consumption and stock values.  Additional details on the selected material; see how the slow-moving indicator has changed over the last 12 months.  Inform colleagues about the slow-moving stock situation. The Slow or Non-Moving Materials app is assigned to the inventory manager, receiving specialist, and shipping specialist standard authorization roles. Figure 7.59 Slow or Non-Moving Materials App Dead Stock Analysis Use the Dead Stock Analysis app (see Figure 7.60) to investigate dead stocks in your enterprise. Dead stocks are material and plant combinations for which the stock value has grown larger despite existing consumption postings over a prescribed time period. Dead stocks can impact an enterprise’s cash flow and profitability. The Dead Stock Analysis app has the following features: 7 Inventory Management 306  Allows monitoring of dead stocks.  Monitors how much working capital is tied up in dead stock.  Monitors dead stock across plants in different countries using a common reporting currency.  Execution of follow-up activities based on the analysis results, such as stock trans- fers or scrapping.  Inform colleagues about the dead stock situation. The Dead Stock Analysis app is assigned to the inventory manager, receiving specialist, and shipping specialist standard authorization roles. Figure 7.60 Dead Stock Analysis App Inventory KPI Analysis The Inventory KPI Analysis app (see Figure 7.61) allows inventory analysts to monitor key process indicator changes over time to ensure forecast and inventory accuracy. The app compares a KPI over two defined time periods and visually represents this in a meaningful way. There are five KPIs that can be monitored using this app:  Stock Changes Change in stock values in the company code currency over the specified time period.  Consumption Changes Change in consumption values of materials over the time period. Consumption value is the sum of the consumption quantities times the current material price.  Inventory Aging Changes Changes in the percentage relationship between the average stock quantity and the consumption quantity over the time period. © 307

**הערת יועץ:** אנליטיקה: ‏Goods Movement Analysis, ‏Inventory Turnover, ‏Slow/Non-Moving, ‏Dead Stock, ו-KPI Analysis (תחלופה, כיסוי, הזדקנות, שינויי-צריכה). מנקודת-מבט מעשית, שלישיית האטיים-המתים-והמזדקנים היא מכרה-הזהב: שם יושב ההון שאפשר לשחרר — והרצת-שגרה רבעונית עליה עם החלטות (למכור? לגרוט? להחזיר?) היא תרגול שמממן את עצמו. יועץ קושר את המדדים ליעדי-המנהל — מה שנמדד מנוהל.

sections.title: Configuring Inventory Management
sections.en: 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management  Inventory Turnover Changes Changes in the relationship between consumption quantities and average stock quantities in the time period.  Range of Coverage Changes Changes in the relationship between the current stock quantity and the average con- sumption (defined as the relationship between consumption and number of days in the time period) in the time period. Details on the KPI calculation logic can be found in the app documentation on the SAP Help website. The Inventory KPI Analysis app is assigned to the inventory analyst standard authori- zation role. Figure 7.61 Inventory KPI Analysis App 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Inventory management is a core supply chain capability of the SAP S/4HANA system. Inventory management functions are delivered by SAP to work based on standard set- tings. However, to realize the full features and functionalities of this component to support an enterprise’s goals, the system does need to be fine-tuned based on business requirements. This section details the standard SAP-recommended configuration steps for inventory management. These settings are made in the SAP S/4HANA system by following the customizing path provided in the following sections for each step. 7 Inventory Management 308 With SAP S/4HANA, it is possible to take advantage of the SAP Best Practices activation approach for customizing, as explained in Chapter 2. However, if you use the tradi- tional customizing approach, this section can help. This information also helps validate the SAP standard configuration. The following management configuration elements are described in the sections ahead:  General configuration elements – Number Assignment assigns customer number ranges to inventory management documents.  Configuration elements for goods receipts and goods issues – Set Expiration Date Check controls how expiration date checking is done in a plant. – Allow Negative Stocks controls whether negative stock balances are allowed and in which storage locations.  Configuration elements for movement types – Record Reasons for Movement Types assigns specific codes to describe the pur- pose of a goods movement. – Copy, Change Movement Types allows the creation of new movement types.  Configuration elements for stock transport purchase orders – Define Shipping Data for Plants assigns the customer and sales area data needed to process stock transport orders with delivery documents. – Configure Delivery Type & Availability Check Procedure by Plant determines the delivery document types used for intracompany and intercompany stock trans- port orders for a plant. – Assign Document Type, One-Step Procedure, Underdelivery Tolerance assigns the proper outbound delivery document type for a specific plant pair. It also contains settings to control one-step or two-step processing and tolerances for goods receipt.  Configuration elements for physical inventory – Default Values for Physical Inventory sets the values that default into each physi- cal inventory document. – Settings for Physical Inventory sets additional values for the control of the physi- cal inventory process for each plant. – Allow Freezing of Book Inventory Balances in Storage Locations controls the freez- ing behavior of book inventories during the physical inventory process. – Cycle Counting sets specific controls for cycle counting per plant. © 309 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management

(המשך 7.5.6 — Inventory KPI Analysis):
• **Inventory Turnover Changes** — שינוי ביחס בין צריכה לכמות מלאי ממוצעת.
• **Range of Coverage Changes** — שינוי ביחס בין כמות המלאי הנוכחית לצריכה הממוצעת (צריכה ÷ ימים).
מוקצה ל-inventory analyst.

**Configuring Inventory Management:** ‏inventory management הוא יכולת ליבה של שרשרת האספקה. מסופק עם הגדרות תקניות, אך נדרש כיוונון לפי הדרישות. ניתן לנצל את גישת SAP Best Practices activation (פרק 2). אם משתמשים בגישה המסורתית, סעיף זה מסייע ולאימות.
אלמנטי התצורה:
• **General** — ‏Number Assignment (הקצאת number ranges למסמכים).
• **GR/GI** — ‏Set Expiration Date Check; ‏Allow Negative Stocks.
• **Movement types** — ‏Record Reasons for Movement Types; ‏Copy, Change Movement Types.
• **STOs** — ‏Define Shipping Data for Plants; ‏Configure Delivery Type & Availability Check Procedure by Plant; ‏Assign Document Type, One-Step Procedure, Underdelivery Tolerance.
• **Physical inventory** — ‏Default Values; ‏Settings; ‏Allow Freezing of Book Inventory Balances; ‏Cycle Counting.

רשימת אלמנטי-התצורה שהסעיף פורש היא מפת-הדרכים לחמשת תת-הסעיפים הבאים, וכדאי לקרוא אותה כמדרג-החלטות: בשכבה הכללית — הקצאת ה-number ranges למסמכים (החלטה אחת, השלכות לכל מסמך); בשכבת הקבלות-והניפוקים — שתי הכרעות-מדיניות אמיתיות: בדיקת תוקף-מדף לטובין מתכלים, והתרת מלאי שלילי (ברירת-מחדל: לא); בשכבת סוגי-התנועה — תיעוד-סיבות והעתקת-types; בשכבת ה-STOs — שלושת מסכי-ההגדרה שמפעילים העברות בין-מפעליות; ובשכבת המלאי-הפיזי — ברירות-מחדל, הקפאת-יתרות ו-cycle counting. ההערה הפותחת חשובה: המערכת מסופקת עם הגדרות תקניות עובדות, וגישת ה-Best Practices activation (מפרק 2) מכסה חלק ניכר — כך שהסעיף משרת שני קהלים: מי שמגדיר מסורתית, ומי שמאמת מה ההפעלה האוטומטית קבעה. העיקרון המנחה לשני הקהלים זהה: כל סטייה מהתקן צריכה הצדקה כתובה — ברירות-המחדל של SAP משקפות עשורי-ניסיון, ושינוי בלתי-מנומק הוא חוב-תחזוקה עתידי.

**הערת יועץ:** מפת-התצורה: מספור, קבלות-וניפוקים (תוקף-מדף, מלאי-שלילי), ‏movement types (סיבות, העתקה), ‏STOs (שלושה מסכים), ומלאי-פיזי (ברירות-מחדל, הקפאה, ‏cycle counting) — עם Best Practices כנקודת-פתיחה. מנקודת-מבט מעשית, רוב הסעיפים הם מדיניות במסווה תצורה — וההכרעות שייכות לעסק, לא ל-IT. יועץ מנהל טבלת-סטיות-מהתקן אחת עם הצדקה לכל שורה — מסמך-ההגנה של התצורה.

sections.title: General Configuration Elements
sections.en: 7.6.1 General Configuration Elements Here, we’ll look at the general configuration elements of inventory management. Number Assignment All goods movements in the SAP S/4HANA system result in material documents. Based on the transaction/event type of the goods movement, a unique number is assigned from a specific number range to the document. Transaction/event types that are rele- vant for SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement in the system are listed in Table 7.3. If you want to use different number ranges than those delivered by SAP, or if you want to reset your number ranges each fiscal year, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Man- agement  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Number Assignment  Define Number Assignment for Material and Phys. Inv. Docs. The Edit Intervals: Mate- rial Document selection screen appears (see Figure 7.62). Click the Change Intervals button. The Edit Intervals: Material Document screen appears (see Figure 7.63). Transaction/ Event Type Grouping Number Range Transaction/ Event Type Description Goods receipts 4900000000– 4999999999 WE Goods receipts for purchase orders WO Subsequent adjustment of sub- contract orders Goods issues/ transfer postings 5000000000– 5999999999 WA Goods issues, transfer postings, other goods receipts WI Material documents for inven- tory adjustment postings Physical inventory 0100000000– 0199999999 IB Physical inventory documents ID Physical inventory documents for counts and differences with- out reference IN Physical inventory documents for recounts Table 7.3 Inventory Management Number Ranges 7 Inventory Management 310 Figure 7.62 Material Document Number Range: Selection Screen Figure 7.63 Material Document Number Range: Interval Maintenance Screen Make any desired additions or changes to the standard number range intervals or the starting values, then press Save. Note that number range configuration changes have to be transported manually to the destination systems. Alternatively, you can maintain number range intervals or sta- tuses directly in the destination system.

| | | ID | מסמכי PI לספירות והפרשים ללא הפניה |
| | | IN | מסמכי PI ל-recounts |

טבלת ה-number ranges שהסעיף מציג היא צוהר לארכיטקטורת-המסמכים: הקבלות חיות בטווח ‏49 עם types ‏WE (קבלות להזמנות) ו-WO (תיקוני קבלן-משנה), הניפוקים וההעברות בטווח ‏50 עם ‏WA (התנועות הכלליות) ו-WI (התאמות-מלאי), והמלאי-הפיזי בטווח ‏01 עם שלישיית ‏IB/ID/IN (מסמכים, ספירות-ללא-הפניה, ו-recounts) — כך שמספר-מסמך לבדו כבר מסגיר את משפחתו, תכונה שחוקרי-תקלות לומדים להעריך. נתיב-השינוי ‏(Define Number Assignment) זמין למי שרוצה טווחים אחרים או איפוס שנתי — אך ההערה הטכנית שבסוף היא החשובה באמת: שינויי number ranges אינם נוסעים אוטומטית ב-transport — מעבירים ידנית או מתחזקים ישירות בכל סביבה — ופער-טווחים בין פיתוח לייצור הוא תקלה קלאסית שמתגלה ברגע הגרוע. ההמלצה המעשית כפולה: לשמור על הטווחים התקניים אלא אם יש סיבה ממשית (רגולציה, ממשקים), ולתעד כל סטייה בטבלה אחת שחיה עם הפרויקט — כולל מי אחראי לסנכרון בין הסביבות.

**הערת יועץ:** מספור: קבלות בטווח 49 ‏(WE/WO), ניפוקים-והעברות ב-50 ‏(WA/WI), מלאי-פיזי ב-01 ‏(IB/ID/IN) — המספר מסגיר את המשפחה. ⚠️ שינויי-טווחים לא נוסעים ב-transport — תחזוקה ידנית פר-סביבה, ופער בין סביבות הוא תקלה קלאסית. מנקודת-מבט מעשית, להישאר על התקני אלא אם רגולציה/ממשקים דורשים — ולתעד כל סטייה עם אחראי-סנכרון. יועץ בודק זהות-טווחים בין הסביבות בכל בריאות-מערכת.

sections.title: Goods Receipts and Goods Issues
sections.en: 7.6.2 Goods Receipts and Goods Issues Let’s take a look at the configuration elements for goods receipts and goods issues. In this section, we’ll explore how to set expiration date checks and how to allow negative stocks. Set Expiration Date Check SAP S/4HANA can check that a perishable item has sufficient shelf life remaining at the time of goods receipt. To do this, a minimum remaining shelf life has to be maintained in the material master record. In addition, the ability to check shelf life for each plant and movement type has to be maintained in configuration. These checks are not enabled in the standard SAP S/4HANA system. The menu path to enable shelf life expiration date checks is IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Goods Receipt  Set Expiration Date Check. The Activate/Deactivate Expiration Date Check screen appears (see Figure 7.64). © 311 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Figure 7.64 Set Expiration Date Check: Selection Screen Press the Plant button. The Activate Expiration Date View per Plant screen appears (see Figure 7.65). Check the Best by Date/Production Date checkbox for the desired plants, then press Save. Figure 7.65 Set Expiration Date Check: Plant Screen Press the Movement Type button. The Expiration Date per Movement screen appears (see Figure 7.66). Check the Check Shelf Life Expiration Date for the desired movement types, then press Save. Figure 7.66 Set Expiration Date Check: Movement Type 7 Inventory Management 312 Allow Negative Stocks Normally there needs to be sufficient stock in a storage location prior to a goods issue or transfer movement that depletes the stock. However, the SAP S/4HANA system can allow negative stock balances for unrestricted stocks in a storage location if the record- ing of goods receipts into that storage location can’t always be done in a timely man- ner. The default setting is to not allow negative stock balances. To make these settings, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Goods Issue/Transfer Postings  Allow Negative Stocks. The Allow Negative Stocks for Valuation Area selection screen appears (see Fig- ure 7.67). Figure 7.67 Allow Negative Stocks: Valuation Area Screen Click the Negative Stocks checkbox for each valuation area in which negative stocks should be allowed. Click the checkbox to the left of the valuation area, then click the Plant level in the hierarchy tree. The Allow Negative Stocks for Plant screen appears (see Figure 7.68). Figure 7.68 Allow Negative Stocks: Plant Screen © 313 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Click the checkboxes for any special stock categories for which negative stocks in that plant are allowed. Then click the Storage Location level in the hierarchy tree. The Allow Negative Stocks for Storage Location screen appears (see Figure 7.69). Figure 7.69 Allow Negative Stocks: Storage Location Screen Click the Negative Stocks checkbox for any storage locations for which negative stocks in that plant are allowed. Then click the Save button.
sections.he:
**Set Expiration Date Check:**
‏S/4HANA יכול לבדוק ש-shelf life מספיק נותר ב-GR. נדרש minimum remaining shelf life באב, ויכולת בדיקה לכל plant ו-movement type בתצורה. לא מאופשר תקנית.
‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Inventory Management and Physical Inventory • Goods Receipt • Set Expiration Date Check (Figure 7.64). לחצו Plant (Figure 7.65) — סמנו Best by Date/Production Date ל-plants, שמרו. לחצו Movement Type (Figure 7.66) — סמנו Check Shelf Life Expiration Date ל-types, שמרו.

**Allow Negative Stocks:**
בדרך כלל נדרש מלאי מספיק לפני GI/transfer. אך ניתן לאפשר יתרות שליליות ל-unrestricted ב-storage location אם רישום ה-GRs לא תמיד בזמן. ברירת המחדל — לא לאפשר.
‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Inventory Management and Physical Inventory • Goods Issue/Transfer Postings • Allow Negative Stocks (Figure 7.67). סמנו Negative Stocks לכל valuation area. ברמת ה-Plant (Figure 7.68) — סמנו special stock categories. ברמת ה-Storage Location (Figure 7.69) — סמנו Negative Stocks ל-storage locations. שמרו.

שתי ההכרעות בסעיף הזה הן מדיניות-אמת במסווה תצורה: בדיקת תוקף-המדף — כבויה תקנית — דורשת שלושה תנאים מצטברים: ‏minimum remaining shelf life ברשומת-החומר, הפעלה ל-plant (עם בחירת Best-by/Production Date), והפעלה ל-movement type — ומרגע שהופעלה, קבלה של טובין שתוקפם קצר מדי נחסמת בשער; לענפי מזון, פארמה וכימיה זו אינה נוחות אלא חובה, והשילוש plant-type-material נותן שליטה עדינה: אילו אתרים בודקים, באילו תנועות, לאילו חומרים. התרת המלאי-השלילי היא ההכרעה הרגישה יותר: ברירת-המחדל (לא) משקפת היגיון בריא — אין לנפק מה שאין — אך המציאות התפעולית מכירה את התרחיש: הסחורה הגיעה פיזית ונצרכה לפני שרישום-הקבלה הושלם, והחסימה עוצרת את הרצפה; ההיתר, המדורג בשלוש רמות (valuation area, ‏plant עם special stocks, ‏storage location), הוא שסתום-לחץ שיש לפתוח בצמצום — כי מלאי שלילי מתמשך הוא סימפטום של תהליך-רישום שבור, לא פתרון. ההמלצה: אם מתירים, לנטר — דוח שליליות שבועי עם חובת-סגירה מהירה.

**הערת יועץ:** שתי הכרעות-מדיניות: תוקף-מדף (כבוי תקנית; דורש min shelf life באב + הפעלת plant + הפעלת type — חובה במזון/פארמה) ומלאי-שלילי (ברירת-מחדל: לא; היתר מדורג ל-valuation area/plant/SLoc). מנקודת-מבט מעשית, השלילי הוא שסתום-לחץ — לא פתרון: שליליות מתמשכת = תהליך-רישום שבור. יועץ שמתיר מוסיף דוח-שליליות שבועי עם חובת-סגירה — ההיתר בלי הניטור הוא רישיון-לבלגן.

sections.title: Movement Types
sections.en: 7.6.3 Movement Types Let’s take a look at movement types and their configuration elements. In this section, we’ll discuss recording reasons for movement types and how to copy and change movement types. Record Reasons for Movement Types It’s possible to have the system record a reason for a goods movement at the time of posting. For example, you can require a reason to be entered when a goods issue to scrapping is performed. With this configuration item, you can require the entry of a reason for a specific movement type and also maintain the valid reasons that can be selected. To make these settings, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Movement Types  Record Reasons for Movement Types. The Reason for Movement screen appears (see Figure 7.70). 7 Inventory Management 314 Figure 7.70 Record Reason for Movement Types: Selection Screen Press the Control Reason button. The Control Reason for Movement screen appears (see Figure 7.71). For each movement type, enter a valid control reason code (required, sup- pressed, or optional). Press the Save button to record your changes. Figure 7.71 Record Reason for Movement Type: Control Reason Screen © 315 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Press the Movement Type button. The Reason for Movement screen appears (see Figure 7.72). Maintain entries for any movement types for which reason codes are required or optional, then press Save. Figure 7.72 Record Reason for Movement Type: Reason Codes Screen Copy, Change Movement Types SAP S/4HANA comes with many movement types, which handle nearly every business inventory transaction. However, it can be desirable to set up new movement types to handle specific situations in your enterprise. For instance, you may want new move- ment types to handle a goods issue for consumption to support research and develop- ment. SAP S/4HANA allows you to create new movement types to support your enterprise’s requirements. There are three rules to follow when creating new movement types: 1. Always copy an existing movement type that is similar to the type of movement you are creating. For example, if you’re creating a new goods issue movement type, copy 7 Inventory Management 316 an existing goods issue movement type. Copy all dependent entries, as there is a large amount of integration of inventory management with other areas of SAP S/4HANA, such as finance and quality management. Don’t attempt to create a move- ment type from scratch! 2. Always copy the copied movement type’s reversal movement type as well. All move- ment types require a reversal movement. 3. There are ranges of codes that SAP sets aside for customer-created movement types. Most SAP S/4HANA customers create new movement types that start with Y, Z, or 9. To copy movement types, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Movement Types  Copy, Change Movement Types. The Field Selection dialog box is shown (see Figure 7.73). Click the Movement Type checkbox, then press the green checkmark at the bottom of the dialog. Figure 7.73 Change, Copy Movement Types: Field Selection Screen The Copy Movement Type screen is shown (see Figure 7.74). Check the movement types you wish to copy in the fields provided, then press the green checkmark at the bottom of the dialog. © 317 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Figure 7.74 Copy, Change Movement Types: Copy Movement Type The Field Selection dialog box is shown (see Figure 7.75). Click the checkbox next to the movement type you want to change. In the dialog box, enter the new movement type and description, then press (Enter). Figure 7.75 Copy, Change Movement Types: Movement Type Selection Double-click the Short Texts folder in the hierarchy tree in the left frame. The Short Texts maintenance screen is shown (see Figure 7.76). Maintain the short and long texts for the new movement type in the fields provided. 7 Inventory Management 318 Figure 7.76 Copy, Change Movement Types: Short Texts Maintenance Screen Double-click the Reversal/Follow-On Movement Types folder in the hierarchy tree in the left frame. The Reversal Movement Type maintenance screen is shown (see Figure 7.77). Maintain the reversal movement types for your new movement type. Press the Save button to save your entries. Figure 7.77 Copy, Change Movement Types: Reversal Movement Type Screen © 319 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Repeat the preceding steps for the reversal movement type to be created. The help documentation for this configuration item contains a lot of good, detailed information about SAP-supplied movement types, how they work, and the stock types and special stocks that they support.
sections.he:
**Record Reasons for Movement Types:**
ניתן שהמערכת תרשום סיבה ב-posting. למשל, לדרוש סיבה ב-GI ל-scrapping. ניתן לדרוש סיבה ל-type ולתחזק את הסיבות התקפות.
‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Inventory Management and Physical Inventory • Movement Types • Record Reasons for Movement Types (Figure 7.70). לחצו Control Reason (Figure 7.71) — לכל type, הזינו control reason code (required/suppressed/optional), שמרו. לחצו Movement Type (Figure 7.72) — תחזקו ל-types שנדרשת/אופציונלית סיבה, שמרו.

**Copy, Change Movement Types:**
‏S/4HANA מגיע עם types רבים. אך ניתן ליצור חדשים. שלושה כללים:
1. תמיד העתיקו type קיים דומה. העתיקו את כל ה-dependent entries (אינטגרציה רבה עם finance, ‏QM). אל תיצרו מאפס.
2. תמיד העתיקו גם את ה-reversal movement type.
3. יש טווחי codes ל-customer types. רוב הלקוחות יוצרים types המתחילים ב-Y, ‏Z, או 9.
‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Inventory Management and Physical Inventory • Movement Types • Copy, Change Movement Types (Figure 7.73). סמנו Movement Type, ‏✓. במסך Copy (Figure 7.74), סמנו את ה-types להעתקה, ‏✓. ב-Field Selection (Figure 7.75), סמנו את ה-type לשינוי, הזינו את החדש ותיאור, ‏Enter.
לחיצה כפולה על Short Texts (Figure 7.76) — תחזקו טקסטים. לחיצה כפולה על Reversal/Follow-On Movement Types (Figure 7.77) — תחזקו את ה-reversal, שמרו. חזרו ל-reversal type. תיעוד העזרה מכיל מידע מפורט על types תקניים.

שני חלקי-הסעיף משרתים שתי צורות-שליטה על שפת-התנועות: תיעוד-הסיבות הופך תנועות רגישות למסבירות-עצמן — הדוגמה הקלאסית היא גריטה: ‏GI ל-scrapping בלי סיבה הוא חור בביקורת, ועם סיבה (פגום, פג-תוקף, נזק-שינוע) הוא נתון-ניתוח; המנגנון הדו-שלבי — קביעת ה-control ‏(required/optional/suppressed) פר-type ותחזוקת קטלוג-הסיבות התקפות — מאפשר משטר מדויק: חובה היכן שהכסף או הרגולציה דורשים, אופציונלי בשאר. והעתקת-ה-types כפופה לשלושה כללי-ברזל שהסעיף מנסח בבהירות נדירה: לעולם להעתיק type דומה קיים על כל ה-dependent entries שלו (האינטגרציה עם הכספים וה-QM עמוקה מכפי שנראה — יצירה מאפס שוברת אותה בשקט), לעולם להעתיק גם את תנועת-הביטול המזווגת (תנועה בלי reversal היא מלכודת), ולמספר בטווחי-הלקוח — ‏Y, ‏Z או 9. רצף-המסכים (העתקה, ‏short texts, ‏reversal/follow-on) מתועד צעד-צעד, והעצה המסכמת: לפני כל יצירת type חדש, לשאול פעמיים אם התקני באמת לא מספיק — כל type מותאם הוא התחייבות-תחזוקה לכל שדרוג.

**הערת יועץ:** סיבות-תנועה (required/optional/suppressed פר-type + קטלוג-סיבות — חובה בגריטה!) והעתקת-types בשלושה כללי-ברזל: להעתיק דומה-קיים על כל ה-dependencies, להעתיק גם את ה-reversal, ולמספר ב-Y/Z/9. מנקודת-מבט מעשית, ⚠️ יצירת type מאפס שוברת אינטגרציית finance/QM בשקט — ולכן לעולם העתקה. יועץ שואל פעמיים לפני כל type חדש: כל מותאם הוא חוב-שדרוג — ורוב הצרכים מכוסים בתקניים.

sections.title: Stock Transport Orders
sections.en: 7.6.4 Stock Transport Orders Let’s examine the configuration elements needed to set up stock transport orders in your system. There are several required settings in configuration needed if you would like to utilize stock transport orders in your enterprise:  Define shipping settings per plant  Set delivery type and availability checking per purchasing document type and sup- plying plant  Set delivery types and set the one-step/two-step process for each plant pair, needed to determine the proper scenario (intracompany or intercompany) and the process by which goods receipts are performed (automatic or manual) Define Shipping Data for Plants These settings are necessary to determine shipping data in the stock transport order line item and to create outbound deliveries. To make the shipping settings per plant, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Purchasing  Purchase Order  Set Up Stock Transport Order  Define Shipping Data for Plants. The Plant Selection screen appears (see Figure 7.78). Figure 7.78 Define Shipping Data for Plants: Selection Screen Click the checkbox next to the plant whose shipping data you would like to maintain, then double-click the plant entry. The Details screen is displayed (see Figure 7.79). 7 Inventory Management 320 Figure 7.79 Define Shipping Data for Plants: Details Screen Maintain the ship-to customer and the sales area information for the plant, then press the Save button. Configure Delivery Type and Availability Check Procedure by Plant These settings are necessary to determine the delivery types for intracompany and intercompany scenarios, along with the proper availability check settings to be used when replenishment deliveries are created. To make these settings per plant, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Purchasing  Purchase Order  Set Up Stock Transport Order  Configure Delivery Type & Availability Check Procedure by Plant. The Overview screen appears (see Figure 7.80). Maintain the delivery and availability check details per purchasing document type and supplying plant, then press the Save button. © 321 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Figure 7.80 Configure Delivery Type and Availability Check Procedure by Plant Assign Document Type, One-Step Procedure, and Underdelivery Tolerance The assign document type, one-step procedure, and underdelivery tolerance settings are needed to determine the proper scenario (intracompany or intercompany) and process by which goods receipt are to be performed (automatic or manual) for each plant pair for which stock transport orders will be used. To make these settings per plant pair, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Purchasing  Purchase Order  Set Up Stock Transport Order  Assign Document Type, One- Step Procedure, Underdelivery Tolerance. The Overview screen appears (see Figure 7.81). 7 Inventory Management 322 Figure 7.81 Assign Delivery Type, One-Step Procedure, Underdelivery Tolerance: Overview Screen Maintain the delivery type, one-step procedure, and underdelivery tolerance settings per supplying and receiving plant pair, then press the Save button.
sections.he:
אלמנטי תצורה ל-STOs:
• Define shipping settings per plant
• Set delivery type ו-availability checking per purchasing document type ו-supplying plant
• Set delivery types ו-one-step/two-step לכל זוג plants (לקביעת התרחיש וה-GR)

**Define Shipping Data for Plants:**
לקביעת shipping data בשורת ה-STO וליצירת outbound deliveries. ‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Purchasing • Purchase Order • Set Up Stock Transport Order • Define Shipping Data for Plants (Figure 7.78). לחיצה כפולה על ה-plant (Figure 7.79). תחזקו ship-to customer ו-sales area, שמרו.

**Configure Delivery Type and Availability Check Procedure by Plant:**
לקביעת delivery types ל-intracompany/intercompany והגדרות availability check. ‏IMG (SPRO) • ... • Set Up Stock Transport Order • Configure Delivery Type & Availability Check Procedure by Plant (Figure 7.80). תחזקו לפי purchasing document type ו-supplying plant, שמרו.

**Assign Document Type, One-Step Procedure, and Underdelivery Tolerance:**
לקביעת התרחיש (intracompany/intercompany) וה-GR (automatic/manual) לכל זוג plants. ‏IMG (SPRO) • ... • Set Up Stock Transport Order • Assign Document Type, One-Step Procedure, Underdelivery Tolerance (Figure 7.81). תחזקו delivery type, ‏one-step procedure, ו-underdelivery tolerance לכל זוג supplying/receiving, שמרו.

שלושת מסכי-התצורה של ה-STO בונים יחד את התשתית להעברות בין-מפעליות, וכל אחד עונה על שאלה אחרת: ‏Define Shipping Data for Plants עונה על 'מי ה-plant בעולם-המשלוחים' — הקצאת ship-to customer ו-sales area לכל plant, כי בהעברה בין-מפעלית ה-plant המקבל מתפקד כלקוח של המשגר, והמסמכים (outbound delivery!) צריכים את הזהות הזו; ‏Configure Delivery Type קובע 'איזה מסמך-משלוח ואיזו בדיקת-זמינות' פר צירוף של document type ו-plant מספק — ההבחנה intracompany/intercompany מקבלת כאן את ביטויה המסמכי; ו-Assign Document Type סוגר את המשולש פר זוג-plants: איזה סוג-מסמך, האם one-step (התנועה נרשמת בצעד אחד — מתאים כשהרישום אחרי המעבר הפיזי) או two-step (יציאה ואז קבלה — נראות מלאה על הדרך), ומה טולרנס תת-האספקה. ההמלצה המעשית: לבנות מטריצת-זוגות — כל צמד מספק-מקבל עם הגדרותיו — לפני הכניסה למסכים; הציור המקדים חושף אי-עקביויות (זוג אחד one-step, תאומו two-step בלי סיבה) שהמסכים עצמם לא יתריעו עליהן.

**הערת יועץ:** שלושת מסכי-ה-STO: ‏shipping data פר-plant ‏(ship-to customer + sales area — ה-plant המקבל הוא 'לקוח'), ‏delivery type ובדיקת-זמינות פר document-type/plant מספק, והקצאה פר זוג-plants ‏(one-step/two-step + טולרנס). מנקודת-מבט מעשית, מטריצת-הזוגות המצוירת-מראש היא המפתח — היא חושפת אי-עקביויות שהמסכים לא יתריעו עליהן. יועץ בונה אותה עם הלוגיסטיקה לפני הכניסה ל-IMG.

sections.title: Physical Inventory
sections.en: 7.6.5 Physical Inventory Now let’s take a look at the configuration elements for physical inventory. Here you’ll see how to configure default values, settings, freezing balances, and cycle counting. Default Values for Physical Inventory This configuration item allows you to set the default values used in the physical inven- tory processes for each plant. Settings are established that default into each physical inventory document created in that plant. To review default values for physical inventory, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Physical Inventory  Default Values for Physical Inventory. The Physical Inventory Settings screen appears (see Figure 7.82). Click the checkbox next to the plant for which you want to maintain default values, then click the Details button. The Physical Inventory Settings screen appears (see Figure 7.83). Determine the default stock type for the documents (1 is unrestricted stock). Click the Batch in Background checkbox for the batches in inventory to be predetermined and copied to the physical inventory document being created. Click the Alternative Unit of Measure checkbox if you want to be able to record counts in alternative units of measure. You can also main- tain a default reason for inventory differences if desired. Press the Save button. © 323 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Figure 7.82 Default Values for Physical Inventory: Plant Selection Screen Figure 7.83 Default Values for Physical Inventory: Plant Details Screen Settings for Physical Inventory This configuration item allows you to make additional detailed settings for physical inventory processing for each plant. Default settings are set by SAP and can be adjusted as necessary. To review default values for physical inventory, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Physical Inventory  Set- tings for Physical Inventory. The Settings for Physical Inventory screen appears (see Fig- ure 7.84). Click the checkbox next to the plant for which you want to maintain settings, then click the Details button. 7 Inventory Management 324 Figure 7.84 Settings for Physical Inventory: Plant Selection Screen The Settings for Physical Inventory screen appears (see Figure 7.85). You can set the sys- tem so that it creates change documents when physical inventory documents are maintained or counts are changed. You can control how the system reacts when book inventories are frozen but goods movements are posted. You can specify if and how serial numbers are displayed on physical inventory count sheets as well. Details of these settings can be found in the field documentation in the system. Press the Save button. Figure 7.85 Settings for Physical Inventory: Plant Details Screen © 325 7.6 Configuring Inventory Management Allow Freezing of Book Inventory Balances in Storage Locations This configuration item allows you to determine if freezing of book inventories will be done when physical inventory documents are activated. If book inventories are frozen, inventory differences found during the count will be calculated from the frozen stock balance. If book inventories are not frozen, then inventory differences will be calcu- lated from the stock balance at the time the count is recorded. This indicator can be set at the storage location level. To allow freezing of book inventory balances in storage locations, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Phys- ical Inventory  Allow Freezing of Book Inventory Balances in Storage Locations. The Determine Work Entry dialog box is displayed (see Figure 7.86). Enter the plant for which settings will be made, then press the green checkmark at the bottom of the dialog. Figure 7.86 Allow Freezing of Book Inventories: Plant Selection The Storage Location screen appears (see Figure 7.87). Click the checkbox next to each stor- age location in the specified plant for which you want to allow freezing of book invento- ries at the time of physical inventory document activation. Press the Save button. Figure 7.87 Allow Freezing of Book Inventories: Storage Location Details 7 Inventory Management 326 Cycle Counting This configuration item allows you to make necessary settings for using the cycle counting method of physical inventory. For each plant, the cycle counting indicators are defined along with settings to determine the frequency of count and float time. These cycle count indicators are set on the material master to determine which materi- als are subject to cycle counting and their relative count frequency. To make cycle counting settings for your plants, navigate to IMG (SPRO)  Materials Management  Inventory Management and Physical Inventory  Physical Inventory  Cycle Counting. The Settings for Cycle Counting screen is displayed as shown in Figure 7.88. Enter the plant, associated cycle counting indicators, and associated settings. Refer to the field documentation in the IMG documentation for detailed explanations of the available settings. Figure 7.88 Cycle Counting Settings

**Default Values for Physical Inventory:**
קביעת ערכי ברירת מחדל לכל plant (שמתמלאים לכל מסמך PI). ‏IMG (SPRO) • Materials Management • Inventory Management and Physical Inventory • Physical Inventory • Default Values for Physical Inventory (Figure 7.82). לחצו Details (Figure 7.83). קבעו default stock type (1 = unrestricted). סמנו Batch in Background (קביעה מראש והעתקה), ‏Alternative Unit of Measure, ו-default reason להפרשים. שמרו.
