sections.title: Central Purchasing
sections.en: 14.3 Central Purchasing The central purchasing scenario of SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edi- tion provides a workplace for the purchaser to create and manage all of the purchase documents for connected backend systems. The purchaser can monitor, display, access, and change the purchasing documents irrespective of whether they are created centrally by an employee using central requisitioning or in any of the connected sys- tems. Central purchasing allows the purchaser to manage and organize the daily tasks and workload to ensure that demands are met, sourced, and converted into purchase orders. Once the purchase orders are released and sent to the supplier, they can then be monitored for follow-on processes such as goods receipts and invoicing processes. In Figure 14.7, purchase requisitions extract from connected systems for processing in the hub system. With SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, the purchas- ing scenario includes the following:  Using the Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally app to manage purchasing and initiate a central sourcing process across connected systems © 555 14.3 Central Purchasing  Closing and deferring purchase requisitions in the Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally app  Synchronizing with the connected system the critical changes in delivery date, material, quantity, price, and deletion of purchase requisitions in the central pur- chase requisition  Assigning, changing, or unassigning a source of supply for extracted purchase requi- sitions  Converting a purchase requisition to a purchase order  Adding a purchase requisition to an existing purchase order  Assign or unassign processors for the selected purchase requisition items  Ability for casual user to change a scenario themselves, as well as edit the plant and company code, in the User Defaults app  Search help integrated with purchasing organization and accounting value in con- nected systems Figure 14.7 Central Procurement Process Flow: Purchasing Organizations can decide to block their purchase requisitions in the hub system, enabling centralized oversight and validation before they are converted into purchase orders and distributed to connected systems and then to suppliers. This approach ensures that all requisitions adhere to company procurement policies and compliance standards, facilitating better control over spending, enhancing cost-effectiveness, and minimizing potential errors in the procurement process. By blocking purchase requisi- tions in the hub system, organizations can make informed decisions, prioritize pro- curement requests, and optimize their overall procurement operations for increased efficiency and accountability. If the Process Centrally switch is on, as in Figure 14.8, the purchase requisition item is blocked from automatic purchase order conversion in the backend. Valid Source of Supply Process PR and Create PO Assign Source of Supply Manage Purchase Orders Centrally Approve PO Invoice Posting Confirm GR PO status update Create PO Approve PR Create PR Connected System PO Extraction PR Extraction No Yes SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition 14 Centralized Procurement 556 Figure 14.8 Process Centrally Switch in Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally App The block ensures that after a source of supply is assigned to the requisition, it can con- tinue to be processed manually by the purchaser and not be immediately picked up by conversion jobs running in the backend and converted into a purchase order. Figure 14.9 Manage Purchase Orders Centrally App © 557 14.3 Central Purchasing Previously, purchase orders were generated manually or through SAP SRM in each ERP system. These orders had to undergo an approval process, adding complexity to the company's order management due to the multiple ERP systems. Purchase orders that are created in the hub system or the ones that have been extracted from other con- nected systems can be managed, as in Figure 14.9, in the Manage Purchase Orders Cen- trally app. The Manage Purchase Orders Centrally app provides the following main features:  Search and filter purchase orders from different connected systems—for example, by approval status or overdue items  Display purchase order details  Create purchase order manually from scratch directly in the connected system  Open and change the purchase order directly in the connected system Central procurement apps such as Manage POs Centrally and Process Purchase Requi- sitions Centrally leverage a data cache of so-called proxy tables for fast searches and to make use of the capabilities of the SAP HANA in-memory database. The original docu- ments still reside in the backend, and data validation, checks, and enrichment happen directly in the backend system. SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition facilitates the integration of attachments linked to the line-item level of a purchase order in the connected system into central purchasing processes. This is achieved through the inclusion of the back- end attachment's document info record in the centrally managed purchase order's object page and the online retrieval and display of the original file from the connected system's content server when the user selects a specific attachment. This integration offers several advantages, including increased transparency in han- dling line-item attachments from connected systems without the necessity of dupli- cating the original files within the hub system. Moreover, it significantly enhances the efficiency of purchase order output from the hub system, encompassing line-item attachments, instead of generating output individually from each connected system. Due to this architecture, the business document IDs remain the original IDs of the backend document. Unlike in other integrated systems, such as SAP SRM and SAP ERP, in which there are sometimes external and internal numbers required for the same PO document, no separate IDs are created for external purchase requisitions or purchase orders in central procurement and there is no need to sync number ranges or define extensive ID mappings. Each procurement document keeps its number assigned by the number ranges in the connected system, making them clearly identifiable to all parties, regardless of whether they are accessing the document from within the Manage Pur- chase Orders Centrally app or directly in the connected system. Even in a single ERP instance, analyzing procurement activities often requires data from disparate areas, such as materials management and accounts payables. In an 14 Centralized Procurement 558 environment with multiple ERPs, this complexity can increase exponentially. Central analytics for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition allows for procure- ment activities to be analyzed throughout the SAP S/4HANA and SAP ERP connected systems. Section 14.6 explains the basic concepts and introduces the available analytics within SAP S/4HANA and SAP Analytics Cloud.
sections.he:
תרחיש ה-central purchasing של SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition מספק workplace לקונה ליצירה וניהול של כל מסמכי הרכש למערכות backend מחוברות. הקונה יכול לנטר, להציג, לגשת, ולשנות את מסמכי הרכש — בין שנוצרו מרכזית ע"י עובד ב-central requisitioning ובין באחת המערכות המחוברות. ‏central purchasing מאפשר לקונה לנהל ולארגן את המשימות והעומס היומיומי כדי להבטיח שביקושים נענים, מתוקצרים, ומומרים ל-purchase orders. לאחר שחרור ה-POs ושליחתם לספק, ניתן לנטר אותם לתהליכי המשך כגון goods receipts ו-invoicing. ב-Figure 14.7, ‏purchase requisitions נחלצים ממערכות מחוברות לעיבוד ב-hub. התרחיש כולל:
• שימוש ב-Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally לניהול הקנייה והתנעת תהליך central sourcing על-פני מערכות מחוברות
• סגירה ודחיית requisitions ב-Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally
• סנכרון עם המערכת המחוברת של שינויים קריטיים ב-delivery date, חומר, כמות, מחיר, ומחיקת requisitions ב-central purchase requisition
• הקצאה, שינוי, או ביטול הקצאה של source of supply ל-requisitions שנחלצו
• המרת requisition ל-purchase order
• הוספת requisition ל-PO קיים
• הקצאה/ביטול הקצאה של processors לפריטי ה-requisition הנבחרים
• יכולת ל-casual user לשנות תרחיש בעצמו, ולערוך plant ו-company code, ב-User Defaults
• ‏search help משולב עם purchasing organization וערך accounting במערכות המחוברות
ארגונים יכולים להחליט לחסום את ה-requisitions ב-hub — מאפשר פיקוח ואימות מרכזיים לפני המרתם ל-POs והפצתם למערכות המחוברות ואז לספקים. גישה זו מבטיחה עמידת כל ה-requisitions במדיניות הרכש ובתקני compliance — שליטה טובה יותר ב-spend, חסכוניות מוגברת, ומיעוט שגיאות. ע"י חסימת requisitions ב-hub, ארגונים מקבלים החלטות מיודעות, מתעדפים בקשות, וממטבים את התפעול.
אם מתג ה-Process Centrally פעיל (Figure 14.8), פריט ה-requisition חסום מהמרת PO אוטומטית ב-backend. החסימה מבטיחה שלאחר הקצאת source of supply, הוא ממשיך לעיבוד ידני ע"י הקונה ולא נקלט מיד ע"י conversion jobs ב-backend ומומר ל-PO.
בעבר, ‏purchase orders נוצרו ידנית או דרך SAP SRM בכל מערכת ERP, ועברו תהליך אישור — מורכבות נוספת בשל מערכות ה-ERP המרובות. ‏POs שנוצרו ב-hub או שנחלצו ממערכות מחוברות ניתנים לניהול (Figure 14.9) ב-Manage Purchase Orders Centrally. תכונות עיקריות:
• חיפוש וסינון POs ממערכות מחוברות שונות — למשל לפי approval status או פריטים שעברו מועד
• הצגת פרטי PO
• יצירת PO ידנית מאפס ישירות במערכת המחוברת
• פתיחה ושינוי של ה-PO ישירות במערכת המחוברת
אפליקציות central procurement כגון Manage POs Centrally ו-Process Purchase Requisitions Centrally ממנפות data cache של proxy tables לחיפושים מהירים ולניצול יכולות מסד הנתונים SAP HANA in-memory. המסמכים המקוריים עדיין שוכנים ב-backend, ו-data validation, בדיקות, והעשרה מתרחשים ישירות ב-backend.
הפתרון מקל על שילוב attachments המקושרים לרמת line-item של PO במערכת המחוברת לתהליכי central purchasing — דרך הכללת ה-document info record של ה-attachment ב-object page של ה-PO המנוהל מרכזית, ושליפה והצגה מקוונת של הקובץ המקורי מ-content server של המערכת המחוברת בבחירת attachment. יתרונות: שקיפות מוגברת בטיפול ב-attachments ממערכות מחוברות ללא כפילות הקבצים ב-hub; שיפור יעילות פלט ה-PO מה-hub, כולל line-item attachments, במקום פלט נפרד מכל מערכת.
בשל ארכיטקטורה זו, מזהי המסמך העסקי נשארים המזהים המקוריים של מסמך ה-backend. בשונה ממערכות משולבות אחרות (כגון SAP SRM ו-SAP ERP) שבהן לעיתים נדרשים מספרים חיצוניים ופנימיים לאותו PO, לא נוצרים מזהים נפרדים ל-requisitions או POs חיצוניים ב-central procurement, ואין צורך לסנכרן number ranges או להגדיר ID mappings נרחבים. כל מסמך שומר את מספרו שהוקצה ע"י ה-number ranges במערכת המחוברת — ניתן לזיהוי ברור לכל הצדדים, בין מ-Manage Purchase Orders Centrally ובין ישירות במערכת המחוברת.
גם ב-instance בודדת, ניתוח פעילויות רכש דורש לרוב נתונים מאזורים שונים (materials management ו-accounts payables). בסביבת multi-ERP, מורכבות זו גדלה אקספוננציאלית. ‏central analytics מאפשר ניתוח פעילויות רכש על-פני מערכות S/4HANA ו-SAP ERP מחוברות. סעיף 14.6 מסביר את המושגים ומציג את ה-analytics הזמינים ב-S/4HANA וב-SAP Analytics Cloud.

sections.title: Central Sourcing
sections.en: 14.4 Central Sourcing The central sourcing scenario within SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edi- tion aims to enhance procurement efficiency by consolidating purchasing activities across different divisions or entities within an organization. This strategy optimizes pro- curement processes, capitalizes on collective purchasing power, and enforces standard- ized terms. Integrating with SAP Ariba and SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA complements this approach by providing a comprehensive platform for supplier engagement, negotiation, and con- tract management. This integration allows organizations to extend their procurement capabilities in the central purchasing organization, access an extensive supplier network, and facilitate end-to-end procurement workflows that encompass sourcing, purchasing, and supplier collaboration. If your purchase requisitions don't have a source of supply, the central purchasing organization may start the sourcing process to find a new supplier or contract. By using the Manage Central RFQs app (see Figure 14.10), you can create a central request for quotation (central RFQ) that includes those purchase requisitions without a source of supply. There are two types of central RFQs: internal and external. The organization's internal policy and the accepted sourcing strategy determine which type of central RFQ to select:  The external request is suitable for scenarios where the organization needs to source products or services that are not readily available internally. It involves inviting external suppliers to provide quotations and bids for the required items or services.  The internal request is suitable for scenarios where external suppliers cannot be involved for some reason. In that case, the central purchasing organization acts as a supplier to submit the supplier's quotation. You can perform the following processes in central sourcing:  Using the Process Purchase Requisition Centrally app to create a central RFQ for pur- chase requisitions without a source of supply  Using the Process Purchase Requisition Centrally app to create central supplier quo- tations in the hub system on behalf of suppliers and award the best quotation  Creating purchase orders or central purchase contracts from the awarded central supplier quotation © 559
sections.he:
תרחיש ה-central sourcing שואף לשפר יעילות רכש ע"י איחוד פעילויות הקנייה על-פני חטיבות/יישויות. אסטרטגיה זו ממטבת תהליכים, ממנפת collective purchasing power, ואוכפת תנאים תקניים. שילוב עם SAP Ariba ו-SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA משלים את הגישה ע"י פלטפורמה מקיפה ל-supplier engagement, משא ומתן, ו-contract management — הרחבת יכולות הרכש ב-central purchasing organization, גישה ל-supplier network נרחב, ו-workflows end-to-end (sourcing, ‏purchasing, ו-supplier collaboration).
אם ל-requisitions אין source of supply, ה-central purchasing organization יכול להתחיל תהליך sourcing למציאת ספק/contract חדש. ב-Manage Central RFQs (Figure 14.10), ניתן ליצור central request for quotation (central RFQ) הכולל requisitions אלו. שני סוגי central RFQs: ‏internal ו-external. מדיניות הארגון ואסטרטגיית ה-sourcing קובעות איזה לבחור:
• **External request** — מתאים לתרחישים שבהם הארגון צריך לתקצר מוצרים/שירותים שאינם זמינים פנימית בקלות. כולל הזמנת ספקים חיצוניים לספק quotations ו-bids.
• **Internal request** — מתאים כשלא ניתן לערב ספקים חיצוניים. אז ה-central purchasing organization פועל כספק להגשת ה-quotation.
תהליכים ב-central sourcing:
• שימוש ב-Process Purchase Requisition Centrally ליצירת central RFQ ל-requisitions ללא source of supply
• שימוש ב-Process Purchase Requisition Centrally ליצירת central supplier quotations ב-hub בשם ספקים והענקת ה-quotation הטוב ביותר
• יצירת purchase orders או central purchase contracts מה-central supplier quotation שזכה

sections.title: Central Purchase Contracts
sections.en: 14.5 Central Purchase Contracts Figure 14.10 Manage Central RFQs App 14.5 Central Purchase Contracts The purpose of central purchasing contracts is to consolidate an organization's pro- curement efforts by establishing standardized terms, conditions, and agreements with suppliers. This approach streamlines the procurement process, enabling cost savings through bulk purchasing, improving supplier relationships, and enhancing transpar- ency and compliance. Ultimately, central purchasing contracts aim to optimize pro- curement efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure consistent and strategic sourcing practices across the organization. The central purchase contracts scenario allows users to centrally create, modify, and view contracts in the hub system. These contracts can then be distributed to connected systems for use as a source of supply. This feature enables purchasers from different organizational units to benefit from the negotiated terms and conditions. Central pro- curement supports both contracts and scheduling agreements. The configuration steps for central contracts are delineated further in Section 14.8.4. Once these configuration steps have been completed, you can perform the following processes in central contracts:  Create central contracts in the central hub system via the Manage Purchase Con- tracts app, including partial distribution of the central contract to the connected ERP systems by company code, quantity, and/or percentage levels. At the central con- tract item level, you can create items from imported material masters, free text 14 Centralized Procurement 560 materials, and lean service items. Using lean service items is only possible for a free text service and results in the creation of a line item with the item category D in the central contract. However, central contracts limit their creation to item category Standard at the header level.  Approve contracts via the My Inbox app.  Distribute the contracts to connected ERP systems.  Create release orders in an individual ERP system against the distributed contract directly.  Import these release orders into the central procurement system via the Schedule Import of Release Orders app. You can start the job immediately or at a specified time, as well as set up the job to be reoccurring or one-time only. You can set the job to do a full, delta, or ad hoc import of the release orders. With release orders imported into central contracts, purchasers have an overview of all of the release orders released against the central contract in the Manage Central Pur- chase Contracts app (see Figure 14.11). Figure 14.11 Manage Central Purchase Contracts In SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA (for more information, see Chapter 11), buyers and producers collaborate to streamline the process of soliciting a group of suppliers. By consolidating and effec- tively managing information, they aim to secure specific components, plan deliveries, and secure the most favorable pricing. The sourcing project and ensuing quotations © 561
sections.he:
מטרת ה-central purchasing contracts לאחד את מאמצי הרכש ע"י ביסוס תנאים, conditions, והסכמים תקניים עם ספקים. גישה זו מייעלת את התהליך, מאפשרת חיסכון דרך bulk purchasing, משפרת קשרי ספק, ומגבירה שקיפות ו-compliance. בסופו של דבר, ‏central purchasing contracts ממטבים יעילות רכש, מפחיתים עלויות, ומבטיחים נוהלי sourcing עקביים ואסטרטגיים בארגון.
תרחיש ה-central purchase contracts מאפשר יצירה, שינוי, וצפייה מרכזיים של contracts ב-hub. ‏contracts אלו מופצים למערכות מחוברות לשימוש כ-source of supply. קונים מיחידות ארגוניות שונות נהנים מהתנאים שהוסכמו. ‏central procurement תומך גם ב-contracts וגם ב-scheduling agreements. צעדי התצורה ל-central contracts בסעיף 14.8.4. לאחריהם, ניתן:
• יצירת central contracts ב-hub דרך Manage Purchase Contracts, כולל הפצה חלקית של ה-central contract למערכות ה-ERP לפי company code, כמות, ו/או percentage. ברמת פריט ה-central contract, ניתן ליצור פריטים מ-material masters מיובאים, ‏free text materials, ו-lean service items. שימוש ב-lean service items אפשרי רק ל-free text service וגורם ליצירת שורה עם item category D ב-central contract. עם זאת, ‏central contracts מגבילים את היצירה ל-item category Standard ברמת ה-header.
• אישור contracts דרך My Inbox.
• הפצת ה-contracts למערכות ה-ERP המחוברות.
• יצירת release orders במערכת ERP בודדת מול ה-contract המופץ ישירות.
• ייבוא ה-release orders למערכת ה-central procurement דרך Schedule Import of Release Orders. ניתן להתחיל את ה-job מיד או בזמן מצוין, ולהגדירו חוזר או חד-פעמי. ניתן להגדיר full, ‏delta, או ad hoc import.
עם ייבוא release orders ל-central contracts, לקונים יש סקירה של כל ה-release orders ששוחררו מול ה-central contract ב-Manage Central Purchase Contracts (Figure 14.11).
ב-SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA (פרק 11), קונים ויצרנים משתפים פעולה לייעול גיוס קבוצת ספקים. ע"י איחוד וניהול יעיל של מידע, הם שואפים להבטיח רכיבים ספציפיים, לתכנן אספקות, ולהבטיח את התמחור הנוח ביותר. ה-sourcing project וה-quotations הנובעות...

sections.title: Central Analytics
sections.en: 14.6 Central Analytics encompass comprehensive details on commodities, their quantities, and preferred commodity pricing engine (CPE) formulas, especially when dealing with materials involving commodities. An awarded quotation can then serve as the foundation for generating a central purchase contract. Commodity procurement is an empowering tool that allows for a user-friendly, formula- based approach to commodity pricing applicable even for future dates, as well as for col- lecting and managing market data rooted in derivative contract specifications (DCS). Users can input and allocate price fixations and perform end-of-period valuations, mak- ing it easier to oversee purchasing documents across diverse industries. Through commodity pricing integration, as shown in Figure 14.12, it becomes feasible to specify the commodities in use and compute item prices by incorporating the com- modity values. Users also have the flexibility to regulate the update cycle of a specific commodity within a central purchase contract based on individual negotiations with the respective supplier, maintaining price data for materials over varying timeframes. These update cycles can range from monthly and quarterly to semiannual or annual, allowing for a more effective way to adapt to external market fluctuations in central contract commodity prices. Figure 14.12 Commodities in Central Purchase Contracts 14.6 Central Analytics Central analytics for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition provides the user with centralized analysis and capabilities for understanding procurement areas holistically, as well at the individual, granular, connected system level with KPIs. The Monitor Purchase Requisition Items Centrally app allows you to monitor purchase requisition items that were created in the hub and purchase requisition items that were extracted from the connected systems (see Figure 14.13). 14 Centralized Procurement 562 Figure 14.13 Monitor Purchase Requisition Items Centrally You also have the Manage Purchase Order Items Centrally app to analyze all your pur- chase orders created throughout the organization (see Figure 14.14). Figure 14.14 Monitor Purchase Order Items Centrally © 563 14.6 Central Analytics Central purchase contract analytics apps provide transparency of purchase contract consumption across an entire organization and enable you to identify where global contracts are not being utilized or being underutilized in areas of the organization. As of SAP S/4HANA Cloud 2308, there are two main apps for central analytics: Central Pur- chase Contract Consumption (see Figure 14.15) and Monitor Central Purchase Contract Items (see Figure 14.16). Figure 14.15 Central Purchase Contract Consumption App Figure 14.16 Monitor Central Purchase Contract Items App 14 Centralized Procurement 564 The central purchase contract consumption key performance indicator shows the val- ues for central contract target versus released amount that are available for the per- sona buyer and analyzes the release versus target spend amounts on contracts by various dimensions:  Supplier  Backend purchasing group  Backend purchasing organization  Backend plant  Material group  Document  Trend  Trend by supplier The user can click a supplier to use it as a filter for analyzing other dimensions for that specific supplier, such as material group, as per Figure 14.17. Figure 14.17 Central Purchase Contract Consumption by Material Group The end user can display the data in central purchase contract consumption using pre- delivered visualizations, dimensions, and measures, as well as sorted by individual set- tings and visualizations, by using the configuration options listed in the dropdown menu shown in Figure 14.18. The document view in Figure 14.19 provides the buyer with the complete release his- tory of all central purchase contracts. By sorting the release percentage, the user can © 565 14.6 Central Analytics view the most consumed contracts on top. If the buyer wants to see the details of a spe- cific contract, drilldown capability is provided. Figure 14.18 Contract Consumption Data Visualization Options Figure 14.19 Contract Data by Document 14 Centralized Procurement 566 Within the central procurement system, there is an analytics app designed to offer insights into price trends within central purchase contract items. The Price History for Central Purchase Contract Items app shown in Figure 14.20 provides:  A detailed analysis of price trends within central contract line items, tracing their origins from the passage of time down to specific price-condition factors.  The ability to distinguish between plant-independent and plant-specific price condi- tions, enabling a more granular understanding of pricing dynamics.  Access to the rationales behind price adjustments at the price-condition level, con- veniently stored within the historical records of each line item in the central con- tract. These insights shed light on the factors driving price changes. Figure 14.20 Price History for Central Purchase Contract Items

sections.title: Integration with SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network
sections.en: 14.7 Integration with SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network As per Figure 14.21, SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition serves as a nexus layer for accessing numerous SAP Ariba solutions:  SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle Performance and SAP Ariba Supplier Risk Management for supplier management  SAP Ariba Sourcing and SAP Ariba Contracts for identifying and transacting with the optimal suppliers for the various spend categories  SAP Business Network for PO/invoice collaboration and automation, financing, and payment facilitation with SAP Pay © 567 14.7 Integration with SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network  Content management with SAP Ariba Catalog  Direct procurement with SAP Business Network Supply Chain Collaboration  Analytics with SAP Analytics Cloud Figure 14.21 Procurement Reference IT Landscape for SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba The main focus area for central requisitioning is SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA, which provides a consumer-grade buying experience on top of SAP Ariba Central Pro- curement, private cloud edition. SAP S/4HANA supports this integration from a rela- tive position of strength. SAP S/4HANA has an expanding prebuilt portfolio of native integrations that can take advantage of solutions in SAP Ariba. In central procurement’s standard integration with SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA, the latter has to send a requisition to the former and have the remainder of the process for converting the requisition to a purchase order occur in central procurement and/or the respective backend systems. The requisition created in SAP Ariba Buying for SAP SAP Business Network Supply Chain Collaboration Procurement Collaboration Logistic Collaboration SAP Ariba Strategic Sourcing Sourcing Contracts SLP SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA Requisitioning Catalogs Asset Management Collaboration SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network Config Wizard Test Central Monitoring SAP S/4HANA for Supplier Quotation Management Supplier Quotations SAP Integration Suite Mapping Transformation Open Connectors Messaging Mapping Repository SAP MDG for Suppliers (Optional) Master Data Governance Master Data Consolidation Sourcing Renegotiations SAP S/4HANA SAP ERP Central Requisitioning Central Purchasing Central Contracts Central Sourcing SAP Ariba SAP BTP SAP S/4HANA, SAP ERP SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA SAP Ariba Central Procure- ment, private cloud edition 14 Centralized Procurement 568 S/4HANA is updated with the purchase order document created in central procurement. This is along the lines of what’s called a classic scenario in SAP SRM connected to a back- end ERP system. SAP SRM creates a requisition/shopping cart and then sends a requisi- tion down to SAP ERP for PO conversion once the SAP SRM shopping cart has been approved. The follow-on processes for PO creation and invoice reconciliation/accounts payable occur in the backend ERP system, with SAP SRM reflecting the follow-on docu- ments. The leading documents after the SAP SRM shopping cart are effectively in SAP ERP. SAP SRM also has an extended classic scenario, whereby the requisition and the pur- chase order are created in SAP SRM and managed there. In SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, you can start the sourcing process for requisitions that do not have valid sources of supply, similar to what we did for shopping carts in SAP SRM. For indirect procurement, the sourcing process can be initiated in SAP Ariba as a part of the central sourcing scenario. This is done by process- ing requisitions extracted from multiple connected systems and then creating the external central request for quotation for them. The other challenge is the data model. Central procurement is flexible in terms of man- aging multiple backend systems and some duplication in the data. If the same supplier record appears in two different forms in two different backend systems, central pro- curement running without SAP Ariba can still route documents to the correct ERP envi- ronment because central procurement creates the document directly in the ERP environment. When adding SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Network for pur- chase order and invoice processing, a one-to-one relationship is needed for supplier data. SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA cannot maintain this duplication of supplier records easily. A supplier logging into SAP Business Network expects one login and not multiple ones based on the backend origin of the supplier record. Maintaining a single catalog for the organization quickly breaks down with the complexities of presenting a single catalog item tied to multiple versions of a supplier, depending upon which com- pany code and backend SAP ERP system will ultimately receive this order. Add in part- ner functionality/supplier hierarchies for multiple invoice locations of a supplier from an SAP ERP environment, and a seemingly simple integration can quickly encounter challenges. In these situations, a further data harmonization step is often required via SAP Master Data Governance (SAP MDG), which is a project (and license) of its own.

‏SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition משמש כשכבת nexus לגישה לפתרונות SAP Ariba רבים (Figure 14.21):
• ‏SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle Performance ו-SAP Ariba Supplier Risk Management ל-supplier management
• ‏SAP Ariba Sourcing ו-SAP Ariba Contracts לזיהוי ועסקאות עם הספקים האופטימליים לקטגוריות spend
• ‏SAP Business Network ל-PO/invoice collaboration ואוטומציה, מימון, ו-payment facilitation עם SAP Pay
• ‏content management עם SAP Ariba Catalog
• רכש ישיר עם SAP Business Network Supply Chain Collaboration
• ‏analytics עם SAP Analytics Cloud
אזור המיקוד העיקרי ל-central requisitioning הוא SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA, המספק חוויית קנייה ברמת-צרכן מעל SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. ‏S/4HANA תומך באינטגרציה זו ממיקום של חוזק יחסי — פורטפוליו מתרחב של אינטגרציות מקוריות מובנות המנצלות פתרונות ב-SAP Ariba.
באינטגרציה התקנית של central procurement עם SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA, האחרון שולח requisition לראשון, ושאר תהליך המרת ה-requisition ל-PO מתרחש ב-central procurement ו/או ב-backends. ה-requisition שנוצר ב-SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA מתעדכן עם מסמך ה-PO שנוצר ב-central procurement. זה דומה למה שנקרא classic scenario ב-SAP SRM המחובר ל-backend ERP: ‏SAP SRM יוצר requisition/shopping cart ושולח requisition ל-SAP ERP להמרת PO לאחר אישור ה-shopping cart. תהליכי ההמשך ליצירת PO ול-invoice reconciliation/accounts payable מתרחשים ב-backend, עם SAP SRM משקף את מסמכי ההמשך. המסמכים המובילים לאחר ה-shopping cart הם למעשה ב-SAP ERP. ל-SAP SRM יש גם extended classic scenario, שבו ה-requisition וה-PO נוצרים ומנוהלים ב-SAP SRM.
ב-SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, ניתן להתחיל את תהליך ה-sourcing ל-requisitions ללא sources of supply תקפים, בדומה ל-shopping carts ב-SAP SRM. לרכש עקיף, תהליך ה-sourcing מותנע ב-SAP Ariba כחלק מתרחיש ה-central sourcing — ע"י עיבוד requisitions שנחלצו ממערכות מחוברות מרובות ויצירת ה-external central request for quotation עבורם.
האתגר האחר הוא ה-data model. ‏central procurement גמיש בניהול מערכות backend מרובות וכפילות מסוימת בנתונים. אם אותה רשומת ספק מופיעה בשתי צורות בשתי מערכות backend, ‏central procurement (ללא SAP Ariba) עדיין יכול לנתב מסמכים לסביבת ה-ERP הנכונה, כי הוא יוצר את המסמך ישירות בסביבת ה-ERP.
בהוספת SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA ו-SAP Business Network לעיבוד PO ו-invoice, נדרש יחס one-to-one לנתוני ספק. ‏SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA אינו יכול לתחזק בקלות את כפילות רשומות הספק. ספק המתחבר ל-SAP Business Network מצפה ל-login אחד ולא למרובים לפי מקור ה-backend. תחזוקת catalog יחיד לארגון מתפרקת מהר עם המורכבות של הצגת פריט catalog יחיד הקשור לגרסאות מרובות של ספק, תלוי באיזה company code ומערכת backend יקבלו את ההזמנה. הוסיפו partner functionality/supplier hierarchies למיקומי invoice מרובים של ספק מסביבת SAP ERP, ואינטגרציה לכאורה פשוטה נתקלת באתגרים. במצבים אלו, נדרש לרוב צעד data harmonization נוסף דרך SAP Master Data Governance (SAP MDG), שהוא פרויקט (ורישיון) בפני עצמו.

sections.title: Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud
sections.en: 14.8 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition From an architectural standpoint, SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edi- tion is an integrated part of the SAP S/4HANA system and code and can be activated and implemented on any SAP S/4HANA instance in parallel with the existing © 569 14.8 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition processes, subject to the purchase of the additional license. This means that any existing SAP S/4HANA instance can be converted into the procurement hub system and that there is no need to purchase additional hardware. Existing processes in this central instance remain untouched and can be run simultaneously without interfer- ing. Within this system you could run the existing SAP S/4HANA procurement pro- cesses, often also referred to as local procurement, and connect them to the central processes of SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. These local pro- cesses are mostly treated like any other backend. In the upcoming sections, we will explore the fundamental setup of the hub system, including establishing connectivity between the hub system and the ERP system, con- figuring the system, and integrating SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA with central procurement.
sections.he:
מבחינה ארכיטקטונית, ‏SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition הוא חלק משולב ממערכת ה-S/4HANA ומהקוד, וניתן להפעלה ולהטמעה בכל instance של S/4HANA במקביל לתהליכים הקיימים, בכפוף לרכישת הרישיון הנוסף. כלומר, כל instance קיימת ניתנת להמרה למערכת ה-procurement hub, ואין צורך לרכוש חומרה נוספת. התהליכים הקיימים ב-instance המרכזי נשארים ללא שינוי ורצים במקביל ללא הפרעה. במערכת זו ניתן להריץ את תהליכי הרכש הקיימים של S/4HANA (נקראים לרוב local procurement) ולחברם לתהליכים המרכזיים. תהליכים מקומיים אלו מטופלים בעיקר כמו כל backend אחר.
בסעיפים הבאים — הקמת ה-hub הבסיסית, כולל ביסוס connectivity בין ה-hub למערכת ה-ERP, תצורת המערכת, ושילוב SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA עם central procurement.

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.en: 14.8.1 Prerequisites With its cloud-first strategy, SAP introduced a concept for SAP S/4HANA in which new developments are designed, developed, and deployed based on cloud principals but then are also made available on premise. Similarly, central procurement as an inte- grated part of SAP S/4HANA can be deployed in the cloud or on premise. Although there are huge differences between these deployment models, especially with regards to ease of consumption, upgrade speed, and software lifecycle, both options provide the same set of functionalities. Differences exist, due to the nature and requirements of the cloud, in how the connection to the backend landscape is realized. The following systems are supported as backends, as shown in Figure 14.22:  SAP ERP EHP 6.06 or greater with add-on HUBERPI  SAP Business Suite on SAP HANA  SAP S/4HANA 1709 or later with add-on HUBS4IC  SAP S/4HANA Cloud system release 2208 Figure 14.22 Versions of Backend Systems Connected to SAP Ariba Central Procurement for SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA Cloud SAP ERP EHP 6 or greater SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition SAP Business Suite on SAP HANA 14 Centralized Procurement 570 For communication with the backends, OData or SOA services are used. Transactional data, such as data in purchase requisitions, is usually transferred via asynchronous SOA services, whereas data validation, lookups, or actions are usually performed with synchronous OData service calls to the backends. The needed interfaces are provided for the on-premise backends as part of an integra- tion add-on—an additional software component that needs to be installed in the back- end systems. This component can be installed easily in the backend and decouples the lifecycle of the interfaces from the complex and costly lifecycle of underlying SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA systems. For any business process that is spread across multiple systems, the biggest challenge is master data. In case of procurement, this data includes materials, suppliers, and accounting information, but also organizational information like material groups or the purchasing organization. In the case of a central system architecture, as with any central procurement hub system, two options can be distinguished: either all master data, business logic, and all business objects can be consolidated into the central sys- tem, or the workplace and business object access and workload organization can be centralized. Consolidation can be a tedious and arduous task. It requires a companywide under- standing of which processes and process-specific data needs to be incorporated into the central process flow, master data harmonization across many systems, or the cre- ation of a mapping and data governance infrastructure. It comes with high TCO, and consolidated processes are usually error-prone and require constant maintenance effort, especially if the backend processes are very heterogenous. In addition, it can slow down innovation cycles in the backends, as well as in the hub, and new features need to be introduced synchronously in the central system and the backend. As shown in Figure 14.23, centralization keeps the business logic and all business docu- ments in the backends, which reduces the need to harmonize or map master data sig- nificantly. Only very few master data elements need to be harmonized or mapped. Mainly these are material groups and purchasing organizations. For central contract management alone, harmonized material master data is required across the backend landscape at this point in time. SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition is not merely a consolidated pur- chase order creation app but a purchasing control center, which allows customers to (remotely) control a global, distributed, and diverse operational procurement ecosys- tem while maintaining analytical and operational transparency and compliance. Before embarking on an SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition imple- mentation or any other implementation, it’s important to review the online documen- tation for the latest information, as well as the version release notes. For SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, the release note is SAP Note 2649491. It is © 571 14.8 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition highly advisable to thoroughly review the public configuration guide before com- mencing any configuration activities for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. This practice ensures that configuration efforts are well-informed and aligned with the system's intended capabilities, thereby minimizing the risk of costly errors or misconfigurations that could potentially disrupt crucial procurement processes. Figure 14.23 Centralizing of Procurement Workplace and Workload It's important to note that new customers who start with SAP S/4HANA Cloud 2011 or a later version use SAP Central Business Configuration as their configuration environ- ment. For those customers who have a different version of the cloud system, they can use the Manage Your Solution app. However, customers who have an on-premise ver- sion can still use Transaction SPRO for functional configurations. For additional infor- mation on the necessary paths for the Manage Your Solution app and Transaction SPRO, refer to the SAP Best Practices for SAP S/4HANA Cloud documentation.
sections.he:
עם אסטרטגיית cloud-first, ‏SAP הציגה מושג שבו פיתוחים חדשים מעוצבים, מפותחים, ונפרסים לפי עקרונות ענן ואז זמינים גם on-premise. בדומה, ‏central procurement (כחלק משולב מ-S/4HANA) ניתן לפריסה בענן או on-premise. אף שיש הבדלים עצומים בין מודלי הפריסה (במיוחד בקלות צריכה, מהירות שדרוג, ו-software lifecycle), שתי האפשרויות מספקות אותו סט פונקציות. הבדלים קיימים, מטבע הענן, באופן מימוש החיבור לנוף ה-backend. המערכות הנתמכות כ-backends (Figure 14.22):
• ‏SAP ERP EHP 6.06 ומעלה עם add-on HUBERPI
• ‏SAP Business Suite on SAP HANA
• ‏SAP S/4HANA 1709 ומעלה עם add-on HUBS4IC
• ‏SAP S/4HANA Cloud system release 2208
לתקשורת עם ה-backends משמשים שירותי OData או SOA. נתונים טרנזקציוניים (כגון ב-requisitions) מועברים בד"כ דרך שירותי SOA אסינכרוניים, בעוד data validation, ‏lookups, או פעולות מבוצעים בד"כ עם קריאות שירות OData סינכרוניות ל-backends.
הממשקים הנדרשים מסופקים ל-backends ה-on-premise כחלק מ-integration add-on — רכיב תוכנה נוסף להתקנה במערכות ה-backend. הרכיב מתקין בקלות ב-backend ומנתק את מחזור החיים של הממשקים ממחזור החיים המורכב והיקר של מערכות SAP ERP/S/4HANA הבסיסיות.
לכל תהליך עסקי המתפרש על מערכות מרובות, האתגר הגדול ביותר הוא master data. ברכש, נתונים אלו כוללים חומרים, ספקים, ומידע accounting, וגם מידע ארגוני כמו material groups או ה-purchasing organization. בארכיטקטורה מרכזית, כמו בכל central procurement hub, שתי אפשרויות: או שכל ה-master data, ה-business logic, וכל ה-business objects מאוחדים למערכת המרכזית, או שה-workplace, גישת ה-business object, וארגון העומס ממורכזים.
איחוד יכול להיות מטלה מייגעת וקשה. דורש הבנה כלל-חברתית אילו תהליכים ונתונים ספציפיים-תהליך יש לשלב בזרימה המרכזית, ‏master data harmonization על-פני מערכות רבות, או יצירת תשתית mapping ו-data governance. מגיע עם TCO גבוה, ותהליכים מאוחדים בד"כ נוטים-לשגיאות ודורשים תחזוקה מתמדת, במיוחד אם תהליכי ה-backend הטרוגניים מאוד. בנוסף, יכול להאט מחזורי חדשנות ב-backends וב-hub, ותכונות חדשות יש להציג סינכרונית במערכת המרכזית וב-backend.
כפי שב-Figure 14.23, מרכוז שומר את ה-business logic וכל המסמכים ב-backends — מצמצם משמעותית את הצורך ב-harmonization/mapping של master data. רק מעט אלמנטי master data דורשים harmonization/mapping — בעיקר material groups ו-purchasing organizations. ל-central contract management לבדו נדרש master data של חומרים מותאם (harmonized) על-פני נוף ה-backend בשלב זה.
‏SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition אינו רק אפליקציית יצירת PO מאוחדת, אלא purchasing control center המאפשר ללקוחות לשלוט (מרחוק) באקוסיסטם רכש תפעולי גלובלי, מבוזר, ומגוון, תוך שמירת שקיפות analytical ותפעולית ו-compliance.
לפני יציאה להטמעה (או כל הטמעה), חשוב לסקור את התיעוד המקוון למידע העדכני וכן את release notes. ל-SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, ה-release note הוא SAP Note 2649491. מומלץ מאוד לסקור ביסודיות את ה-public configuration guide לפני כל פעילות תצורה — מבטיח שמאמצי התצורה מיודעים ומיושרים עם היכולות, וממזער סיכון לשגיאות או misconfigurations יקרות.
חשוב לציין: לקוחות חדשים המתחילים עם S/4HANA Cloud 2011 ומעלה משתמשים ב-SAP Central Business Configuration כסביבת התצורה. לקוחות עם גרסת ענן אחרת יכולים להשתמש ב-Manage Your Solution. לקוחות on-premise עדיין יכולים להשתמש ב-Transaction SPRO לתצורות פונקציונליות. למידע על ה-paths ל-Manage Your Solution ו-Transaction SPRO, ראו תיעוד SAP Best Practices for SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

sections.title: Establishing Connectivity to ERP Systems
sections.en: 14.8.2 Establishing Connectivity to ERP Systems The first step is setting up connectivity to the necessary ERP systems to be managed by SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. This is a cross-scenario configu- ration activity for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. With the SAP_ BR_BPC_EXPERT and SAP_BR_ADMINISTRATOR roles or their equivalents assigned to your user, you first need the Basis team to create RFC connections to each ERP environment using Transaction SM59. The Basis team should create ABAP and HTTPS connection RFCs along with an SAP Gateway system alias in table /IWFND/V_DFSYAL. The Basis team then needs to create the logical system references in your hub environment for each connected ERP system using Transaction BD54. Finally, the Basis team ties the RFCs to the logical systems’ BAPI calls in Transaction BD97 by entering the RFC connection in the field shown in Figure 14.24. Configuring connections between SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edi- tion and ERP systems is a fundamental aspect of streamlining procurement opera- tions. The following sections explore the foundational configurations required to establish seamless connectivity. These configurations play a key role in ensuring that data synchronization and collaboration between the central procurement hub and ERP SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition Connected System PurchaseRequisitionReplicationRe- quest_Out PurchaseRequisitionReplicationRe- quest_ In PurchaseRequisitionReplicationConfir- mationB_In PurchaseRequisitionReplicationConfir- mation_Out PurchaseRequisitionSourcingNotifica- tion_In PurchaseRequisitionSourcingNotifica- tion_Out Table 14.1 Services Namespaces for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition © 573 14.8 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition instances function effectively, facilitating harmonious and efficient procurement pro- cesses within the organization. Defining Org Structure and Logical Systems Next, you need to define the company codes and plants to be used in the scenarios at the Define Company Code, Plant, and Purchasing Organization for Connected System activity. On the Change View for Connected Systems screen, enter your logical systems created in the previous steps for the general entry as shown in Figure 14.25, the company codes as shown in Figure 14.26, and the plants and purchasing organizations. Figure 14.25 Connected Systems Central Procurement Figure 14.26 Connected Company Codes As of version 2308, you can also maintain the control plane for the APIs of central pro- curement via the Configure Control Plane for APIs of Central Procurement activity. For more information on this topic, review documentation related to the central procure- ment scope items. 14 Centralized Procurement 574 Establishing OData Connections Basis now needs to establish OData connections between the backend connected sys- tems and the SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition environment. The OData services in Table 14.2 need to be established for each connected backend system. Here you should also have Basis set up an SAP Gateway cache management approach (determin- ing how often the cache will be checked and cleared, as well as whether parallelization for batch queries is required). Activating Change Pointers Next, activate change pointers by following menu path SPRO  SAP Netweaver  Appli- cation Server  IDoc Interfaces/ALE  Modeling and Implementing Business Processes  Master Data Distribution  Replication of Modified Data  Activate Change Pointers or using Transaction BD61. For central requisitioning, you next need to enter and maintain two message types, HUBSOS and HUBPR, by following menu path SPRO  Integration with Other Compo- nents  Advanced Planning and Optimization  Basic Settings for the Data Transfer  Change Transfer  Change Transfer for Master Data  Activate ALE and Change Pointers for Message Types. You’ll need to update these message types via menu path SPRO  Logistics  General  Material Master  Global Data Synchronization  Set Change Docu- ment Items for Message Type. הצעד הראשון — הקמת connectivity למערכות ה-ERP הנדרשות לניהול ע"י SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. זוהי פעילות תצורה חוצת-תרחישים. עם ה-roles ‏SAP_BR_BPC_EXPERT ו-SAP_BR_ADMINISTRATOR (או שווי-ערך) מוקצים, ראשית צוות ה-Basis צריך ליצור RFC connections לכל סביבת ERP בעזרת Transaction SM59. הצוות יוצר ABAP ו-HTTPS connection RFCs יחד עם SAP Gateway system alias בטבלה /IWFND/V_DFSYAL. אז יוצר את ה-logical system references בסביבת ה-hub לכל מערכת ERP מחוברת בעזרת Transaction BD54. לבסוף, קושר את ה-RFCs ל-BAPI calls של ה-logical systems ב-Transaction BD97 ע"י הזנת ה-RFC connection בשדה (Figure 14.24).
ה-services/namespaces ב-Table 14.1 דורשים תצורה לשילוב הפתרון דרך SAP PI או חיבורי point-to-point. תצורת החיבורים בין הפתרון למערכות ה-ERP היא היבט יסודי בייעול תפעול הרכש. התצורות הבאות מבטיחות data synchronization ו-collaboration אפקטיביים בין ה-hub למערכות ה-ERP.

| PurchaseRequisitionReplicationRequest_Out | PurchaseRequisitionReplicationRequest_In |

בהמשך, יש להגדיר את ה-company codes וה-plants לשימוש בתרחישים בפעילות Define Company Code, Plant, and Purchasing Organization for Connected System.
במסך Change View for Connected Systems, הזינו את ה-logical systems שנוצרו לרשומה הכללית (Figure 14.25), את ה-company codes (Figure 14.26), ואת ה-plants וה-purchasing organizations.
מ-version 2308, ניתן לתחזק גם את ה-control plane ל-APIs של central procurement דרך Configure Control Plane for APIs of Central Procurement (ראו תיעוד scope items).

**Establishing OData Connections:**
‏Basis צריך כעת לבסס OData connections בין ה-backends לסביבת הפתרון. שירותי ה-OData ב-Table 14.2 דורשים ביסוס לכל backend מחובר.

sections.title: Validating Data and Identifying Gaps
sections.en: 14.8.3 Validating Data and Identifying Gaps With SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition utilizing centralization as its key principal, the need to synchronize data, including master data, is greatly reduced. To provide fast access, easy search capabilities, and analytical functions, SAP Ariba Cen- tral Procurement, private cloud edition uses the underlying SAP HANA in-memory database technology. Information about the business documents from the different backends is updated continuously into SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition, and all read access to any document happens via this cached data within the SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition solution. Via OData interfaces in the backends, changed or newly created business objects are updated as per Figure 14.27. Figure 14.27 Overview of SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition Architecture and Data Flow The update cycles can be customized, and programs for initially filling the cache tables in the hub are available. The option to restrict the business objects to be transferred to the central system is also available. The data import is consistently tracked and moni- tored by appropriate logging functionality so that errors can be identified and resolved. With the ad hoc import functionality, it’s also possible to manually import only specific documents at any given point in time. Here you maintain the backend logical system and the types of records to be extracted, as shown in Figure 14.28. Figure 14.28 Setting Central Procurement Extraction Options Next, if you want to be able to search catalogs using a common currency, you must enable the search bar for cross-catalog search. Go to activity Define Settings for Cross- Catalog Search. Clear the Hide Search Bar checkbox and save, as shown in Figure 14.29. sections.he:
מכיוון שהפתרון מנצל centralization כעיקרון מפתח, הצורך לסנכרן נתונים (כולל master data) מצטמצם מאוד.
לגישה מהירה, חיפוש קל, ופונקציות analytical, הפתרון משתמש בטכנולוגיית SAP HANA in-memory הבסיסית. מידע על המסמכים העסקיים מה-backends השונים מתעדכן ברציפות לפתרון, וכל גישת קריאה למסמך מתרחשת דרך הנתונים המ-cached בתוך הפתרון. דרך ממשקי OData ב-backends, ‏business objects ששונו או נוצרו מתעדכנים (Figure 14.27).
מחזורי העדכון ניתנים להתאמה, וקיימות תוכניות למילוי ראשוני של טבלאות ה-cache ב-hub. קיימת גם אפשרות להגביל את ה-business objects המועברים למערכת המרכזית. ייבוא הנתונים נמעקב וננוטר ע"י logging מתאים לזיהוי ופתרון שגיאות. עם פונקציית ה-ad hoc import, ניתן גם לייבא ידנית רק מסמכים ספציפיים בכל עת.
לסינון נתונים שנחלצים לפתרון, עברו ל-Define Additional Filter Options for Source of Supply Extraction. כאן מתחזקים את ה-backend logical system וסוגי הרשומות לחילוץ (Figure 14.28).
אם רוצים לחפש catalogs במטבע משותף, יש לאפשר את ה-search bar ל-cross-catalog search. עברו ל-Define Settings for Cross-Catalog Search. נקו את ה-checkbox‏ Hide Search Bar ושמרו (Figure 14.29).
אם נדרש harmonize של material groups בין מערכות — כלומר אם ל-backends material groups שונים מהמערכות האחרות ו/או מסביבת S/4HANA — עברו ל-Define Material Groups והזינו את ה-material groups הנוספים (Figure 14.30).
בדומה, אם יש purchasing groups במערכות ה-ERP, ניתן ליצורם בסביבת S/4HANA בעזרת Create Purchasing Groups.

sections.title: Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition
sections.en: 14.8.4 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition Scenarios SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition covers a wide array of function- alities that can be used to manage procurement activities in a distributed ERP environ- ment. Customers can choose to deploy all the available central procurement scenarios or only select ones. The central procurement scenarios available include requisition- ing, purchasing, sourcing, contracts, and analytics. The following sections detail further steps required for configuring individual scenarios, beginning with requisitioning, for SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition. For the most current setup doc- umentation for all available versions, including cloud versions, visit http://s-prs.co/ 500313. The steps for activating the SAP S/4HANA procurement hub after completing the gen- eral connectivity steps are as follows: 1. Log into the SAP S/4HANA hub system and execute Transaction SPRO. 2. Navigate to the Activate SAP S/4HANA Procurement Hub and Scenarios configura- tion activity. 3. In the Change View “Hub Activation” Overview screen, shown in Figure 14.31, choose New Entries and then check the Activate HUB checkbox. 4. Choose Save. Note that once saved, the SAP S/4HANA environment becomes a hub for central procurement. This step is a permanent step, so be sure that you have con- firmed the environment prior to saving. © 579 14.8 Configuring SAP Ariba Central Procurement, Private Cloud Edition Figure 14.31 Hub Activation The following sections describe how to activate and perform basic settings for the hub scenarios. Central Requisitioning The steps for activating the central requisitioning scenario are as follows: 1. Log into the SAP S/4HANA hub system and execute Transaction SPRO. 2. Navigate to the Activate SAP S/4HANA Procurement Hub and Scenarios configura- tion activity. 3. In the dialog structure area, choose Scenario Activation. 4. In the Change View “Scenario Activation”: Overview screen, choose New Entries and then select Central Requisitioning under Activate Scenarios for Procurement Hub, as shown in Figure 14.32. 5. Choose Save. Figure 14.32 Activate Central Requisitioning 14 Centralized Procurement 580 You can extend the central requisitioning scenario in the Custom Fields and Logic app by implementing logic for the Business Add-Ins (BAdIs) in Table 14.3. If you want to have purchase requisitions automatically convert into Pos in the back- end systems, an option is available in SAP S/4HANA via menu path SPRO  Materials Management  Purchasing  Purchase Order  Enable Automatic Creation of PO from Replicated Central PR, as shown in Figure 14.33. Figure 14.33 Enable Automatic Creation of PO In SAP S/4HANA, you can enable the automatic creation of the PO by following these steps: 1. Log into the connected system (SAP S/4HANA) and execute Transaction SM30. 2. Enter “VMMPUR_POCREATE” for the View Name, then choose Edit. 3. Choose the Create PO checkbox. 4. Choose Save. Next, schedule a job to extract data for catalog items from the backend systems based on your filter settings, as follows: 1. Log into the SAP Fiori launchpad with a user that has the SAP_BR_BPC_EXPERT role. 2. In the Purchasing Configuration section, go to the Schedule Import of Catalog Data app. 3. On the Application Jobs screen, select New. 4. In the General Information area, Job Template and Job Name can be named Import Catalog Data. The job name can be changed later if required. ‏SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition מכסה מגוון רחב של פונקציות לניהול רכש בסביבת ERP מבוזרת. לקוחות יכולים לפרוס את כל תרחישי ה-central procurement או רק נבחרים: ‏requisitioning, ‏purchasing, ‏sourcing, ‏contracts, ו-analytics. הסעיפים הבאים מפרטים צעדים לתצורת התרחישים הבודדים, החל מ-requisitioning. לתיעוד ההקמה העדכני לכל הגרסאות (כולל ענן) — http://s-prs.co/500313.
צעדי הפעלת ה-procurement hub לאחר צעדי ה-connectivity הכלליים:
1. התחברו ל-hub והריצו Transaction SPRO.
2. נווטו לפעילות Activate SAP S/4HANA Procurement Hub and Scenarios.
3. במסך Change View "Hub Activation" Overview (Figure 14.31), בחרו New Entries וסמנו Activate HUB.
4. בחרו Save. **הערה:** לאחר השמירה, סביבת ה-S/4HANA הופכת ל-hub ל-central procurement. צעד זה קבוע — ודאו את הסביבה לפני השמירה.

**Central Requisitioning:**
1. התחברו ל-hub והריצו Transaction SPRO.
2. נווטו ל-Activate SAP S/4HANA Procurement Hub and Scenarios.
3. באזור dialog structure, בחרו Scenario Activation.
4. במסך Change View "Scenario Activation": Overview, בחרו New Entries וסמנו Central Requisitioning תחת Activate Scenarios for Procurement Hub (Figure 14.32).
5. בחרו Save.
ניתן להרחיב את התרחיש ב-Custom Fields and Logic ע"י מימוש לוגיקה ל-BAdIs ב-Table 14.3.

**Table 14.3 — BAdIs ל-Central Requisitioning:**

| Business Context | תיאור BAdI |
|---|---|
| Procurement: Purchase Requisition Item | Change of Self-Service Purchase Requisition in Central Procurement |
| Procurement: Agent Determination in Flexible Workflow | Determination of Workflow Agents for Purchasing Documents |

להמרה אוטומטית של requisitions ל-POs ב-backends, אפשרות זמינה ב-S/4HANA דרך SPRO • Materials Management • Purchasing • Purchase Order • Enable Automatic Creation of PO from Replicated Central PR (Figure 14.33). ב-S/4HANA, להפעלת היצירה האוטומטית:
1. התחברו למערכת המחוברת (S/4HANA) והריצו Transaction SM30.
2. הזינו "VMMPUR_POCREATE" ל-View Name, בחרו Edit.
3. סמנו Create PO.
4. בחרו Save.
בהמשך, תזמנו job לחילוץ נתוני catalog items מה-backends לפי הגדרות הסינון:
1. התחברו ל-Fiori launchpad עם משתמש בעל role‏ SAP_BR_BPC_EXPERT.
2. בסעיף Purchasing Configuration, עברו ל-Schedule Import of Catalog Data.
3. במסך Application Jobs, בחרו New.
4. ב-General Information, ‏Job Template ו-Job Name = Import Catalog Data (ניתן לשנות מאוחר).
5. לשינוי אפשרויות התזמון, לחצו Define Recurrence Pattern (אחרת ה-job יתחיל מיד).
6. במסך Scheduling Information, בחרו את האפשרות, תחזקו את השדות, ‏OK.
7. באזור Catalog Data תחת Customizing Parameters, פרמטרי הייבוא נבחרים אוטומטית לפי ה-customizing הקודם.
8. באזור Catalog Data תחת Web Service, בחרו Multi_Backend והזינו: ‏Connected System, ‏Company Code, ‏Plant, ‏Choose Import Type (full/delta), ‏Full Import (Material Group או Material), ‏Material Group From/To, ‏Material From/To.
9. בחרו Schedule ואמתו השלמה תחת Application Jobs ו-Scheduled Jobs.

**Central Purchasing:**
כמו ב-requisitioning ו-contracts, ודאו תחילה שצעדי ה-connectivity ואימות הנתונים נסקרו. ניתן להרחיב את התרחיש ב-Custom Fields and Logic ע"י מימוש לוגיקה ל-BAdIs ב-Table 14.4.

**Table 14.4 — BAdIs ל-Central Purchasing:**

| Business Context | תיאור BAdI |
|---|---|
| Procurement: Extracted Purchase Requisition | Change of Purchase Requisitions During Extraction (MM_PUR_S4_MODIFY_EXTRACTED_PR) |
| Procurement: Extracted Purchase Requisition | Assigning of Default Values to Search Fields for Proxy Purchase Orders (MMPUR_PROXY_PO_SEARCH_FLDS_DEF) |
| Procurement: Extracted Purchase Requisition | Assigning of Default Values to Search Fields for Central Purchase Contracts (MMPUR_CCTR_SEARCH_FIELDS_DEF) |
| Procurement: Central Purchasing Document / Item | Change of Purchase Order Data during Extraction (MM_PUR_S4_MODIFY_EXTRACTED_PO) |
| Procurement: Grouping of Extracted Purchase Requisitions | Change of Grouping Criteria of Extracted PRs During PO Creation (MM_PUR_EXT_PURREQN_GRP_CHANGE) |
| Procurement: Flexible Workflow | Determining Workflow Agents for Centrally Managed Purchase Requisitions (MMPUR_PR_RPL_WORKFLOW_AGENTS) |
| Procurement: Flexible Workflow | Determining Workflow Agents for Centrally Managed Purchase Orders (MMPUR_CPO_WORKFLOW_AGENTS) |
| Procurement Automation | Check of Documents in Business Process Automation (MMPUR_BUSPROC_AUTMN_ACTION_CHK) |
| Procurement Automation | Change of Documents in Business Process Automation (MMPUR_BUSPROC_AUTMN_ACTION_SET) |
| Central Procurement: Purchase Orders / Items | Mapping of Extensible Fields for Centrally Managed Purchase Orders (MM_PUR_HUB_PO_FIELD_MAPPING) |
| Central Procurement: Purchase Orders / Items / Requisitions | Map Extensible Fields for Follow-on Documents (MM_PUR_EXT_PR_FOD_CUST_FLD_MAP) |
| Central Procurement: Purchase Orders / Items | Customize Text for Changed Fields (MMPUR_PDOC_CHANGE_TEXT) |
| Central Procurement: Purchase Requisitions | Mapping of Extensible Fields for Centrally Managed Purchase Requisitions (MM_PUR_HUB_PR_FIELD_MAPPING) |

תזמנו import job ל-purchasing requisitions, orders, ו-purchasing texts:
1. התחברו ל-Fiori launchpad עם role‏ SAP_BR_BPC_EXPERT.
2. בסעיף Job Scheduling for Purchasing, עברו ל-Schedule Import of Purchasing Documents.
3. במסך Application Jobs, בחרו New.
4. במסך New Job, תחת General Information: ‏Job Template = Import Purchasing Requisitions from Connected Systems; ‏Job Name למשל "Import Purchasing Requisitions from Connected Systems". ‏Scheduling Options מוגדר להתחיל מיד כברירת-מחדל (Figure 14.34).
5. לשינוי, בחרו Define Recurrence Pattern (Figure 14.35).
6. במסך Scheduling Information, בחרו אפשרות, תחזקו, ‏OK.
7. באזור Import Type, בחרו ל-connected system ID: ‏Full Import, ‏Delta Import, או Ad Hoc Import.
8. חזרו על הצעדים ל-purchasing texts, ‏purchase orders, והיסטוריית POs.
לאפשור החלפת נתונים בין המערכת החיצונית ל-hub של S/4HANA Cloud דרך הודעות SOA/XML:
1. התחברו ל-Fiori launchpad עם role‏ SAP_BR_ADMINISTRATOR.
2. בסעיף Communication Management, נווטו ל-Communication Systems.
3. במסך Communication System, בחרו New.
4. ב-popup, הזינו System ID ו-System Name, בחרו Create.
5. ב-General Data, השאירו את שם המערכת.
6. ב-Technical Data, תחזקו: ‏Host Name, ‏HTTPS Port, ‏Is Hub System (Yes), ‏Use Cloud Connector.
7. ב-Contact Information, תחזקו את המידע.
8. להוספת User ל-Outbound Communication, בחרו Add.
9. ב-popup‏ New Outbound User, בחרו Authentication Method עם User Name ו-Password, הזינו את פרטי המערכת החיצונית, ‏Create.
10. בחרו Save.
11. נווטו ל-Communication Arrangements.
12. במסך Maintain Communication Arrangements, בחרו New.
13. ב-popup: ‏Scenario = SAP_COM_0673 (SAP S/4HANA Procurement Hub—Centrally Managed PO with Supplier Integration); ‏Arrangement Name. בחרו Create.
14. במסך Communication Arrangement, ב-Common Data, תחזקו את ה-communication system ID מהצעד הקודם.
15. ב-Outbound Services, תחזקו Path for Procurement Hub Replicated Purchase Order—Send. ה-path ספציפי למערכת היעד וניתן ע"י הספק בלבד, או חיבור ל-SAP Cloud Integration לחיבור ספקים מרובים.
16. בחרו Save.
בהמשך, הגדירו output parameter determination:
1. ‏Fiori launchpad עם role‏ SAP_BR_ADMINISTRATOR.
2. בסעיף Output Control, נווטו ל-Output Parameter Determination.
3. הזינו: ‏Show Rules for = Procurement hub replicated purchase orders; ‏Determination Step = Channel.
4. ב-Maintain Business Rules, בחרו Edit.

sections.title: Integrating SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA with Central Procurement
sections.en: 14.8.5 Integrating SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA with Central Procurement The integration between SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition includes further restrictions at the time of this writing, which are slated to be addressed in future releases of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. The following list of SAP Notes outline the specific limitations that apply to each central procurement scenario:  For central procurement with SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA: SAP Note 3282610  For central procurement with SAP Ariba Sourcing: SAP Note 3235436  For central procurement with SAP Ariba Contracts: SAP Note 3233089 SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition is no better with regard to these limitations as of version 2308. If you’re planning to integrate this solution into your system, first verify the requirements for SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba in general and determine what integration limitations still apply. Your data situ- ation with multiple backends may also require SAP Master Data Governance to harmo- nize, especially if you have duplicate supplier records, supplier hierarchies, and partners set up in your backend ERP systems or other duplicate or diverging master data. For more information on the current limitations and on the overall process flow for an SAP Ariba Buying for SAP S/4HANA to SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition integration, visit http://s-prs.co/500316. For the SAP Best Practices, including automated configuration options, visit http://s-prs.co/500317.  Procurement: Purchasing Document  Procurement: Purchasing Document Item  Procurement: Purchasing Document Distribution Restart of Flexible Workflow for Central Pur- chase Contracts (MM_PUR_S4_CCTR_WF_ TRGGR)  Procurement: Purchasing Document  Procurement: Purchasing Document Distribution Mapping of Header Extension Details to Dis- tributed Purchase Outline Agreements (MM_ PUR_S4_MAP_DISTR_OA_HEADER)  Procurement: Purchasing Document Item  Procurement: Purchasing Document Distribution Mapping of Item Extension Details to Distrib- uted Purchase Outline Agreements (MM_PUR_ S4_MAP_DISTR_OA_ITEM) Business Context BAdI Description Table 14.9 Business Add-Ins for Central Purchasing Contract Extension (Cont.) 14 Centralized Procurement 592

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 14.9 Summary SAP Ariba Central Procurement, private cloud edition has evolved significantly since its inception, positioning itself as the future-proof platform for orchestrating procurement activities across diverse ERP systems. This evolution showcases not only advanced capa- bilities surpassing those of previous SAP SRM solutions but also ongoing efforts to enhance integration with SAP Ariba solutions or SAP Ariba Direct Materials Sourcing for Automotive and Industrial Manufacturing in SAP S/4HANA, addressing process and functionality limitations. By adopting this robust solution, customers stand to gain a multitude of benefits. One of the primary advantages is the streamlining of procurement operations, result- ing in heightened efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Central procurement empowers organizations to centralize procurement activities, fostering transparency and simpli- fying complex procurement processes. Furthermore, the integration potential with SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network opens new avenues for collaboration and supplier management. This synergy allows companies to optimize supplier relationships, enhance supplier diversity, and imple- ment strategic sourcing initiatives. The result is a more agile and responsive procure- ment function, capable of adapting to changing market conditions and delivering exceptional value to customers. ©

sections.title: Spend Visibility
sections.en: 15.1 Spend Visibility Like finance and controlling, a procurement department has a strong focus on spend- ing. Unlike finance, the chief interests of which are cash flow and controlling costs, pro- curement seeks to understand what is being bought and whether more optimal approaches exist for categorizing and grouping this spend, as well as supporting it via Procurement Analytics Real-Time Reporting and Monitoring Spend Visibility Spend Reporting 15 Sourcing and Procurement Analytics 594 agreements with suppliers. Spend visibility, also called spend analysis, provides the procurement team with reporting in this area, combining financial/transactional reporting in which payments are being made to suppliers with the upstream areas, meaning the requisitioning, sourcing, and contracting areas of the transaction. The dif- ference between a classic approach to spend visibility and the approach in SAP S/4HANA is detailed in Figure 15.2. Figure 15.2 Classic versus SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement Spend Visibility In a classic approach for spend visibility, the SAP ERP system didn’t conduct an extraction in real time, and there were no KPI options. Because the data had been extracted to another environment, drilling down into the minutia of a transaction or supporting financials wasn’t always possible, either. For this, you had to return to the transaction system to further query data and/or rebuild your data cubes in your busi- ness warehouse to show the sought-after data. SAP S/4HANA still allows for extraction of data to a business warehouse if required, but you can also conduct KPI-based analy- sis in real time in the transacting system. This makes the view into your spending up to date and actionable in an immediate timeframe when required. With its multidimensional spend report, SAP S/4HANA Cloud offers further extensions for spend reporting in later releases. The multidimensional purchasing spend report in SAP S/4HANA Cloud allows for purchasing spend to be analyzed dynamically by com- pany code, region, plant, and other variables. The user can drag and drop dimensions, as well as change and adopt filters, dimensions, and measures in rows and columns. Users can flip between a table, bar, or split chart display. As with multidimensional spend reporting, users can also move between table, bar, or split chart displays for monitoring and reporting in SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procure- ment. Buyers and executives can analyze and report on spend, contracts, and suppliers, as well as monitor business-critical situations in the procurement overview page using analytical cards and worklists. Analytical cards are screen elements in an overview page. An overview page can show many charts and figures on one page, and the user can navi- gate to further applications by clicking the figures and/or charts contained in the card. Optional: Data extraction Classic SAP S/4HANA Traditional With SAP S/4HANA Process Excellence Data extraction SAP ERP SAP SRM SAP Business Warehouse SAP S/4HANA analytical apps Drill downs into documents Batch Job SAP S/4HANA Direct access SAP BW © 595 15.1 Spend Visibility The Procurement Overview Page app provides a graphical dashboard display of key procurement and supplier management reports, as in Figure 15.3. Figure 15.3 Procurement Overview Page App As of SAP S/4HANA 1909, you can also analyze the efficiency of your approval work- flows with the Purchase Requisition Average Approval Time (Flexible Workflow) app, using a KPI to monitor approval time for flexible workflow–based requisitions. You can also use the Purchase Order Item Changes app, which allows you analyze what types of changes are being made in the POs, as shown in Figure 15.4. This insight allows you to further optimize processes to address areas causing frequent updates to POs. Figure 15.4 Purchase Order Item Changes App 15 Sourcing and Procurement Analytics 596
