sections.title: Integrating SAP Fieldglass Contingent Workforce Management
sections.en: 16.6.2 Integrating SAP Fieldglass Contingent Workforce Management SAP Fieldglass integrates both directly into SAP S/4HANA and via SAP Ariba. This sec- tion provides further overviews of both options. Integrating SAP Fieldglass via SAP Ariba The process flow for integrating SAP Fieldglass via SAP Ariba is illustrated in Figure 16.44. Figure 16.44 SAP Fieldglass Integration with SAP Ariba SAP Fieldglass integrates with SAP Ariba via the standard SAP Integration Suite, man- aged gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network extractors and loaders. The integration can be mediated via customer middleware or go directly via webservice calls. Nonstandard requirements can be supported using custom-developed SAP Inte- gration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network extractors and loaders. SAP Fieldglass is used to augment SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network functionality and processes in service procurement in the following ways:  Managing workers in each SOW engagement by doing the following: – On/offboarding and provisioning – Tenure and performance tracking – Tracking and managing expenses – Tracking contractor record and related documents – Offloading data entry to the services supplier  Managing engagement-specific supplier performance by doing the following: – Tracking deliverables – Rolling up engagement and relationship levels Create Statement of Work Export Requisition to SAP Ariba I need an ABAP developer! Create Requisition Approval Copy Purchase Order Create Purchase Order Import Purchase Order Create SAP S/4HANA Purchase Order Release SOW to Supplier Supplier Submits Timesheet Timesheet Validation Approval Create Invoice Create SAP S/4HANA Vendor Invoice Invoice Matched and Approved Invoice Status Copy Invoice • Posted • Processed • Paid • Reconciled • Rejected • Cancelled • Parked • Deleted SAP Fieldglass SAP ERP SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA Cloud *SAP ERP integration requires ASAPIO Netweaver Adapter *SAP S/4HANA integration uses SAP Cloud Integration Suite package SAP Ariba Buying SAP Business Network Commerce Automation 16 Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Signavio, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, and SAP Fieldglass 654 – Providing the supplier with configurable views into performance – Providing users with drilldown, real-time supplier KPI scorecards  Downstreaming SOW authoring and supplier collaboration.  Managing downstream authoring and supplier collaboration by doing the follow- ing: – Providing self-service, buyer-centric SOW development tools and processes – Offering collaboration options for supplier/buyer on engagement structure and pricing – Ensuring configurability across payment characteristics  Providing timecard functionality by doing the following: – Allocating hours across jobs, project codes, and cost centers – Offering complex rate-management capabilities – Rate benchmarking – Offering mobile capabilities  Providing a managed service provider (MSP) governance model by doing the follow- ing: – Offering native project management architecture and configurability via work- flow changes, reports, and custom fields – Offering single-tenant/multi-msp functionality – Offering an administrative panel for alerts and tactical tracking SAP Fieldglass can leverage SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing for a unified UI, a network for distributing POs and invoices (SAP Business Network), and approval workflows in both systems. SAP Fieldglass also integrates with SAP Ariba Contracts for managing spend. For more information on SAP Fieldglass integration with SAP Ariba/SAP Busi- ness Network solutions, please visit http://s-prs.co/500331. For integrating with SAP Business Network, visit http://s-prs.co/v500332. Integrating SAP Fieldglass Directly with SAP S/4HANA The process flow for having SAP S/4HANA integrated with SAP Fieldglass directly is illustrated in Figure 16.45. You can also begin creating the SOW in SAP Fieldglass instead of starting in SAP S/4HANA using this process flow. The standard integration areas and scenarios for integrating SAP Fieldglass directly into SAP S/4HANA center on the following:  Replicating business partners. The business partner/supplier is first created and saved in the SAP S/4HANA system, and then pushed via automated direct connectiv- ity integration out to SAP Fieldglass. A passthrough option for the supplier is also available via SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and © 655 16.6 SAP Fieldglass SAP Business Network. Once the business partner is loaded into SAP Fieldglass, the user manually selects the supplier required to register and initiates an email regis- tration invitation, and the supplier registers/creates their user information. Figure 16.45 Integration of SAP Fieldglass Directly into SAP S/4HANA  Replicating master data. For replicating data from SAP S/4HANA to SAP Fieldglass, you can leverage SAP Fieldglass web service technical specifications (BusinessPart- nerRelationshipPush). Via SOA Manager, SAP S/4HANA can be configured for direct connectivity. Mediated connectivity can be set up via SAP Integration Suite, man- aged gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network or SAP PI/SAP PO. Mediated connectivity is the recommended approach as it enables the systems to pass data with additional security controls in place and doesn’t expose the URL of SAP S/4HANA to external systems. In either case, you can replicate sales and internal orders, cost centers, work breakdown structure (WBS) elements, company codes, purchasing orgs, and plants. Mapping specifications for import are provided by SAP Fieldglass.  Creation of transactional data. Here the requester creates a work order or SOW in SAP Fieldglass and passes it along for approval. SAP S/4HANA converts the work order or SOW into a high-level requisition and can drive the approval process using existing workflows in the SAP S/4HANA environment, using the SAP Fieldglass req- uisition response connector to send a status update to SAP Fieldglass once approved or rejected, along with the purchase requisition ID.  If rejected, SAP Fieldglass opens up the work order or SOW for editing and resubmis- sion back to SAP S/4HANA. Once approved, the purchase requisition custom field in SAP Fieldglass is updated with this status in the Posting Information section of the work order or SOW (Details tab). Once any additional workflow steps in SAP Fieldg- lass are completed, the system issues a work order to the supplier for confirmation in SAP Fieldglass and then consequently issues a PO via SAP S/4HANA. Create Work Order/ SOW Create Work Order/ SOW Export Service Order Export Requisition Update with SAP PR # Create SAP S/4HANA Service Order Update Work Order/ SOW with SAP S/4HANA PO Number Approve Timesheet/ Service Entry Sheet Export Service Entry Sheet Approval Create Invoice Export Invoice Invoice Status Create SAP S/4HANA Vendor Invoice Invoice Matched and Approved SAP Fieldglass SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA Cloud Suppliers Create SAP S/4HANA Service Entry Sheet Create SAP S/4HANA Requisition SAP Fiori Launchpad Release Assignment to Supplier Supplier Submit Timesheet/ Service Entry 16 Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Signavio, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, and SAP Fieldglass 656  SOW processing. The supplier accepts SOWs via a response request in SAP Fieldglass. Once approved by the buyer, the object moves into pending external acceptance sta- tus and SAP Fieldglass triggers the creation of a formal purchase order in SAP S/4HANA. SAP S/4HANA runs this request through any approvals required, issues the PO, and then sends a PO ID back to SAP Fieldglass. Applicable worker times and expense sheets can then be submitted back to SAP S/4HANA via a webservice inte- gration task push. Utilizing the SAP Fieldglass entry status upload connector, SAP S/4HANA can send back status updates.  Regardless of whether service entry sheet functionality integration is enabled between the two systems, any invoiced element in SAP Fieldglass can be integrated with and sent to the SAP S/4HANA system. SAP Fieldglass leverages a download con- nector called CXML-formatted invoices to retrieve all invoices available on the client and process them in SAP S/4HANA. SAP S/4HANA then sends back a final payment status for the invoice to SAP Fieldglass.  There are two procurement workflows available in the form of lean procurement and standard procurement. Lean includes service entry integrations, but not service hierarchies, and is the go-to integration workflow going forward. Standard procure- ment is only supported in on-premise SAP S/4HANA environments and does not include service entry integrations.
sections.he:
‏SAP Fieldglass משתלבת גם ישירות ל-S/4HANA וגם דרך SAP Ariba.

**שילוב SAP Fieldglass דרך SAP Ariba:** זרימת התהליך ב-Figure 16.44. ‏SAP Fieldglass משתלבת עם SAP Ariba דרך ה-extractors וה-loaders התקניים של SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Network. האינטגרציה מתווכת דרך middleware של הלקוח או ישירות דרך webservice calls. דרישות לא-תקניות נתמכות עם extractors/loaders מותאמים. ‏SAP Fieldglass מעשירה את הפונקציה והתהליכים של SAP Ariba ו-SAP Business Network ב-service procurement:
• ניהול עובדים בכל SOW engagement: ‏on/offboarding ו-provisioning; ‏tenure ו-performance tracking; מעקב וניהול הוצאות; מעקב רשומת contractor ומסמכים; הסטת הזנת נתונים לספק השירות.
• ניהול ביצועי ספק ספציפיים-engagement: מעקב deliverables; גלגול רמות engagement ו-relationship; תצוגות ביצוע מותאמות לספק; ‏drilldown ו-real-time supplier KPI scorecards.
• הסטת SOW authoring ו-supplier collaboration ל-downstream.
• ניהול authoring ו-collaboration downstream: כלי SOW development self-service ממוקדי-קונה; אפשרויות collaboration ל-supplier/buyer על מבנה ותמחור; configurability על-פני payment characteristics.
• פונקציית timecard: הקצאת שעות על-פני jobs, ‏project codes, ו-cost centers; יכולות rate-management מורכבות; ‏rate benchmarking; יכולות mobile.
• מודל ממשל managed service provider (MSP): ארכיטקטורת project management מקורית ו-configurability דרך שינויי workflow, דוחות, ושדות מותאמים; ‏single-tenant/multi-msp; פאנל מנהלי ל-alerts ומעקב טקטי.
‏SAP Fieldglass יכולה למנף את SAP Ariba Buying and Invoicing ל-UI מאוחד, ‏network להפצת POs ו-invoices (SAP Business Network), ו-approval workflows בשתי המערכות. משתלבת גם עם SAP Ariba Contracts לניהול spend. למידע — http://s-prs.co/500331; לשילוב עם SAP Business Network — http://s-prs.co/v500332.

**שילוב SAP Fieldglass ישירות עם S/4HANA:** זרימת התהליך ב-Figure 16.45. ניתן גם להתחיל ביצירת ה-SOW ב-SAP Fieldglass במקום ב-S/4HANA. אזורי האינטגרציה התקניים:
• **שכפול business partners** — ה-business partner/supplier נוצר ונשמר תחילה ב-S/4HANA, ואז נדחף דרך אינטגרציה אוטומטית ישירה ל-SAP Fieldglass. אפשרות passthrough זמינה גם דרך SAP Integration Suite. לאחר טעינת ה-business partner ל-SAP Fieldglass, המשתמש בוחר ידנית את הספק לרישום ומתניע הזמנת רישום ב-email, והספק נרשם/יוצר את פרטי המשתמש.
• **שכפול master data** — לשכפול נתונים מ-S/4HANA ל-SAP Fieldglass, ניתן למנף את המפרט הטכני של webservice (BusinessPartnerRelationshipPush). דרך SOA Manager, ‏S/4HANA ניתן להגדרה ל-direct connectivity. ‏mediated connectivity דרך SAP Integration Suite או SAP PI/SAP PO. ‏mediated connectivity היא הגישה המומלצת — מעבירה נתונים עם בקרות אבטחה נוספות ואינה חושפת את ה-URL של S/4HANA. בכל מקרה, ניתן לשכפל sales ו-internal orders, ‏cost centers, ‏work breakdown structure (WBS) elements, ‏company codes, ‏purchasing orgs, ו-plants. מפרטי mapping לייבוא מסופקים ע"י SAP Fieldglass.
• **יצירת transactional data** — ה-requester יוצר work order או SOW ב-SAP Fieldglass ומעביר לאישור. ‏S/4HANA ממיר ל-requisition ברמה-גבוהה ומניע את תהליך האישור בעזרת workflows קיימים, ומשתמש ב-SAP Fieldglass requisition response connector לשליחת עדכון סטטוס ל-SAP Fieldglass לאחר אישור/דחייה, עם ה-purchase requisition ID.
• אם נדחה, ‏SAP Fieldglass פותח את ה-work order/SOW לעריכה והגשה-מחדש. לאחר אישור, שדה ה-purchase requisition המותאם ב-SAP Fieldglass מעודכן בסטטוס בסעיף Posting Information (לשונית Details). לאחר השלמת צעדי workflow נוספים, המערכת מנפיקה work order לספק לאישור ב-SAP Fieldglass, ואז מנפיקה PO דרך S/4HANA.
• **עיבוד SOW** — הספק מקבל SOWs דרך response request ב-SAP Fieldglass. לאחר אישור הקונה, האובייקט עובר ל-pending external acceptance ו-SAP Fieldglass מתניע יצירת PO פורמלי ב-S/4HANA. ‏S/4HANA מריץ דרך האישורים הנדרשים, מנפיק את ה-PO, ושולח PO ID חזרה. ‏times ו-expense sheets של העובד נשלחים חזרה ל-S/4HANA דרך webservice integration task push. בעזרת SAP Fieldglass entry status upload connector, ‏S/4HANA שולח עדכוני סטטוס.
• ללא קשר אם אינטגרציית service entry sheet מאופשרת, כל אלמנט שחויב ב-SAP Fieldglass ניתן לשילוב ולשליחה ל-S/4HANA. ‏SAP Fieldglass ממנף download connector בשם CXML-formatted invoices לאחזור כל ה-invoices הזמינים אצל הלקוח ועיבודם ב-S/4HANA. ‏S/4HANA שולח חזרה final payment status.
• שני procurement workflows: ‏lean procurement ו-standard procurement. ‏lean כולל אינטגרציות service entry אך לא service hierarchies, והוא ה-workflow המועדף קדימה. ‏standard נתמך רק ב-S/4HANA on-premise ואינו כולל אינטגרציות service entry.

sections.title: SAP SuccessFactors
sections.en: 16.7 SAP SuccessFactors SAP SuccessFactors integration with both SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud has a similar integration framework and approach as that for SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network, based on predefined integration scenarios that you evaluate, activate, and deploy in your environment.
sections.he: אינטגרציית SAP SuccessFactors עם S/4HANA ו-S/4HANA Cloud בעלת מסגרת וגישה דומות לאלו של SAP Ariba ו-SAP Business Network — מבוססת תרחישי אינטגרציה מוגדרים-מראש שמעריכים, מפעילים, ופורסים.

sections.title: SAP S/4HANA Integration with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central
sections.en: 16.7.1 SAP S/4HANA Integration with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central SAP S/4HANA integrates with SAP SuccessFactors by leveraging predefined configura- tion and integration scenarios (see Figure 16.46). This integration is web service-based and can be scheduled as a middleware job. The manual process entails creating or identifying a cost center first in SAP S/4HANA. This is a manual step. The cost center is then transferred to SAP SuccessFactors and assigned to the employee. The employee and/or organizational data is transferred back to SAP S/4HANA automatically via batch processing. The configuration is available at http://s-prs.co/500320. This includes overview documentation, scope documentation, and the following accelerators:  Sales supplement, an overview of the package and business value  Customer presentation, slides on the scope of integration © 657 16.7 SAP SuccessFactors  Demo script, for communicating the scope and functionality  Delivery supplement, providing important information about the delivery of the solution  Service and one-page slides, slides defining the solution and scope (one-pagers)  Software and delivery requirements, a list of prerequisites for the deployment of the solution  Solution scope, scope documents  Project schedule, a schedule for the project including roles/skills required  SAP Notes, providing additional documentation for the package and implementation Figure 16.46 SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Integration with SAP S/4HANA
sections.he:
‏S/4HANA משתלב עם SAP SuccessFactors ע"י מינוף תצורה ותרחישי אינטגרציה מוגדרים-מראש (Figure 16.46). האינטגרציה מבוססת web service וניתנת לתזמון כ-middleware job.
התהליך הידני: יצירה/זיהוי של cost center תחילה ב-S/4HANA (צעד ידני). ה-cost center מועבר ל-SAP SuccessFactors ומוקצה לעובד. נתוני העובד/הארגון מועברים חזרה ל-S/4HANA אוטומטית דרך batch processing. התצורה ב-http://s-prs.co/500320, כולל תיעוד סקירה, תיעוד scope, וה-accelerators:
• ‏Sales supplement — סקירת החבילה והערך העסקי

• ‏Service ו-one-page slides — שקפים המגדירים את הפתרון וה-scope

sections.title: SAP Cloud Integration with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central
sections.en: 16.7.2 SAP Cloud Integration with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central SAP SuccessFactors can also integrate with SAP S/4HANA Cloud using the same approach of best practices, building blocks, and SAP Activate. The required efforts are slightly more varied, and therefore involved, than with the SAP Business Network pack- ages. Upon completion of the integration, the employee from SAP SuccessFactors is realized as a business partner in SAP S/4HANA. Data from SAP SuccessFactors can be used to populate the employee data in SAP S/4HANA, such as the following:  Basic employee information (person, name, employee)  Communication information, such as email, phone, and fax  Payment information with payment method and bank account  Employee status  Employment percentage  Working hours per week SAP S/4HANA SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Enter cost center Cost center transfer Assign cost center to employee Cost center transfer Employee transfer Run business processes Employee transfer Organizational transfer Organizational transfer SAP Integration Suite 16 Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Signavio, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, and SAP Fieldglass 658  Job title  Job information, business unit, division, and department  Cost center assignment As with single-tenant SAP S/4HANA integrations, from a process standpoint, you first establish or identify the cost center in SAP S/4HANA, then transfer this cost center to SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assign an employee, and then transfer the employee record back over to SAP S/4HANA (see Figure 16.47). The transfer processes are automated process steps, whereas the cost center assignment is manual. Figure 16.47 SAP SuccessFactors Transfer to SAP S/4HANA for Employee Records More on SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central integration building blocks and integra- tion information is available at http://s-prs.co/500320, where you’ll find the latest inte- gration information, as well as the following:  A process diagram, which outlines the integration approach.  A test script, for verification of implementation.  Process model BPMN2.  For contingent labor integration with SAP SuccessFactors, you can review the 1Q0 Best Practice scenario.
sections.he:
‏SAP SuccessFactors יכול להשתלב גם עם S/4HANA Cloud באותה גישה של best practices, ‏building blocks, ו-SAP Activate. המאמצים מעט מגוונים ולכן מורכבים יותר מחבילות SAP Business Network. בסיום, העובד מ-SAP SuccessFactors ממומש כ-business partner ב-S/4HANA. נתונים מ-SAP SuccessFactors יכולים לאכלס את נתוני העובד ב-S/4HANA:
• מידע עובד בסיסי (person, ‏name, ‏employee)
• מידע תקשורת (email, ‏phone, ‏fax)
• מידע תשלום עם payment method ו-bank account
• ‏employee status
• ‏employment percentage
• שעות עבודה לשבוע
• ‏job title
• ‏job information, ‏business unit, ‏division, ו-department
• ‏cost center assignment
כמו באינטגרציות S/4HANA single-tenant, מבחינת תהליך: תחילה מבססים/מזהים את ה-cost center ב-S/4HANA, מעבירים ל-SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central ומקצים עובד, ומעבירים את רשומת העובד חזרה ל-S/4HANA (Figure 16.47). תהליכי ההעברה אוטומטיים; הקצאת ה-cost center ידנית.
מידע נוסף על building blocks ו-integration — http://s-prs.co/500320, כולל:

sections.title: SAP Signavio
sections.en: 16.8 SAP Signavio The SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite is an end-to-end process man- agement solution for understanding, improving, and transforming all of your business processes. SAP Signavio solutions support your intelligent process mining initiatives, allowing you to find improvement areas faster while accelerating your time to adoption SAP S/4HANA Cloud SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Enter cost center Cost center transfer Assign cost center to employee Cost center transfer Employee transfer Create business partner, vendor, user Employee transfer Run processes using employees as business partner or vendor SAP Integration Suite © 659 16.8 SAP Signavio for process changes. In addition, SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite provides a framework of common standards to drive collaboration strategies. As per Figure 16.48, this in turn creates a positive feedback loop via which to drive the organi- zation forward. Figure 16.48 SAP Signavio Feedback Loop SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite comprises four areas, as in Figure 16.49: 1 Process analysis and mining Complete process analysis for enterprise transformation and operational excellence programs 2 Process journey modeling Standardized process and journey management, simulation, and modeling 3 Process governance and automated execution Maintaining organizational and regulatory compliance for all documented pro- cesses 4 Process collaboration Stakeholder alignment and active collaboration across departments Integration of SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite with SAP S/4HANA and other SAP solutions, including SAP Solution Manager, requires different approaches depending on the type of integration. For initial data loads, you can export your data from the target application and load it into SAP Signavio using the Importing Dictionary Entries app in SAP Signavio to create the corresponding entries. For syncing data with SAP Signavio Process Manager, you can use LeanIX, which has a special interface avail- able for syncing data with SAP Signavio. The SAP Signavio Process Manager REST API supports custom integrations. For more information on LeanIX, visit https://docs- eam.leanix.net/docs/sap-signavio-integration. For general information on SAP Signavio 16 Integrating SAP S/4HANA with SAP Signavio, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, and SAP Fieldglass 660 and integrating SAP Signavio with other applications and data sources, visit https:// help.sap.com/docs/signavio-process-manager. Figure 16.49 SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite

‏SAP Signavio Business Process Transformation Suite הוא פתרון process management end-to-end להבנה, שיפור, וטרנספורמציה של כל התהליכים העסקיים. פתרונות SAP Signavio תומכים ביוזמות intelligent process mining — מציאת אזורי שיפור מהר יותר תוך זירוז time to adoption לשינויי תהליך. בנוסף, הם מספקים מסגרת תקנים משותפים להנעת אסטרטגיות collaboration. כפי שב-Figure 16.48, זה יוצר feedback loop חיובי להנעת הארגון קדימה.
ה-suite כולל ארבעה אזורים (Figure 16.49):
1. **Process analysis and mining** — ניתוח תהליך מלא לתוכניות טרנספורמציה ו-operational excellence
2. **Process journey modeling** — ניהול, סימולציה, ומידול תקניים של תהליך ו-journey

שילוב ה-suite עם S/4HANA ופתרונות SAP אחרים (כולל SAP Solution Manager) דורש גישות שונות לפי סוג האינטגרציה. ל-initial data loads, ניתן לייצא נתונים מהיישום ולטעון ל-SAP Signavio בעזרת Importing Dictionary Entries. לסנכרון נתונים עם SAP Signavio Process Manager, ניתן להשתמש ב-LeanIX (בעל ממשק מיוחד לסנכרון). ה-SAP Signavio Process Manager REST API תומך באינטגרציות מותאמות. למידע על LeanIX — https://docs-eam.leanix.net/docs/sap-signavio-integration. למידע כללי — https://help.sap.com/docs/signavio-process-manager.

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 16.9 Summary Although cloud solutions offer unprecedented savings in maintenance and ease of use, data and processes from ERP systems, such as SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA, are often core for augmenting and completing processes in SAP Ariba and SAP Business Net- work. This chapter outlined several integration options for pairing SAP’s cloud portfo- lio solutions for procurement with SAP S/4HANA environments. For SAP Ariba and SAP Business Network, many of these integrations are here today and accessible via the native integrations in SAP S/4HANA and accessible comprehensively as part of SAP Integration Suite, managed gateway for spend management and SAP Business Net- work. For integration, more and more of these linkages are being built and will be native out of the box for future releases in all of SAP’s cloud solutions. However, just because something is an SAP cloud solution doesn’t mean that it’s completely integrated in all ways with SAP’s digital core solutions today. For now, understanding your integration requirements and options for your project is key for successfully realizing the end-to- end processes in SAP’s cloud and on-premise solutions. Next, we’ll discuss the SAP Fiori UI approach in SAP S/4HANA. sections.title: User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA
sections.en: 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA The two main UI options in SAP S/4HANA are SAP Fiori and reverting to the SAP GUI transactions familiar to users of older versions of SAP ERP, which we will discuss in the following sections. Many of these transactions are still an option in SAP S/4HANA, but not adopting SAP Fiori and the apps approach in SAP S/4HANA precludes users from leveraging many of the new features of SAP S/4HANA contained only in the apps. First, let’s look at SAP Fiori. There are four different types of apps, as detailed in Table 17.1. 17 Customizing the User Interface 662

sections.title: SAP Fiori
sections.en: 17.1.1 SAP Fiori Many UI approaches of the past created an overwhelming cockpit of controls, buttons, and levers, confounding users looking to accomplish specific tasks in the system. SAP Fiori instead emphasizes role-based interaction while still allowing for adaptability and flexibility so that users can apply functionality beyond a single path or process. This emphasis on simplicity, rather than feature overload, carries over into the other core tenets of SAP Fiori, which are as follows:  Role-based—that is, designed for you, your needs, and how you work  Adaptive—that is, adapts to multiple use cases and devices  Coherent—that is, provides one fluid, intuitive experience  Simple—that is, includes only what’s necessary  Delightful—that is, makes an emotional connection In the following sections, we’ll introduce you to SAP Fiori and then discuss the launch- pad, its architecture, SAP Business Client, and the deployment options for SAP Fiori. Overview SAP Fiori provides its role-based, consumer-grade UX across all lines of business. SAP Fiori 3 is the latest evolution of the UX for SAP S/4HANA and provides consistency, intelligence, and integration. It provides a harmonized look and feel across products, enables embedded machine learning and automation of mundane tasks, and makes Transactional App Based Upon… Description SAPUI5 Represent simplified views of existing business processes and solu- tions. Generally run on any database, except when built/shipped on SAP S/4HANA. You can find a full list of all SAPUI5 versions at https:// ui5.sap.com/versionoverview.html. Development tools include Visual Studio Code and SAP Business Application Studio. SAP Fiori elements Dynamic SAPUI5 apps controlled by metadata annotations in SAPUI5, SAP Gateway, or CDS views. List reports are common SAP Fiori ele- ments. SAP GUI SAP GUI transactions are an official part of SAP Fiori. Create Purchase Order (Advanced) is an example of an SAP GUI–based app. Web Dynpro Web Dynpro apps are similar to SAP GUI apps in that they are also part of SAP Fiori since SAP Fiori 2.0. Web Dynpro apps run exclusively on the SAP S/4HANA database. Table 17.1 SAP Transactional Application Types © 663 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA integration of content from different products simpler. SAP Fiori 3 enriches the UX with intuitive, easy-to-use apps that run on both mobile devices and computers. SAP Fiori apps help zero in on key functions, tasks, and activities for the user. SAP Fiori over- view pages allow users to get live KPIs and action items, including lists of contracts that will expire in the near future. SAP Fiori apps are categorized as transactional, analytical, and object page types. Transactional apps run business transactions, and object page apps display master data and documents. Analytical apps, as the name suggests, are used to analyze live data for instant business insights. These apps also provide the capability to act based on insights. Detailed information on all the apps is available at http://s-prs.co/500303. SAP Fiori 3 provides a harmonized user experience across all SAP applications, includ- ing cloud solutions. The SAP Fiori visual theme known as Quartz comes in light and dark flavors. SAP Fiori apps are not developed yet for some SAP GUI transactions. How- ever, these classic SAP GUI transactions are made available in the SAP Fiori theme to support a seamless user experience across the SAP Fiori launchpad. These apps run in the backend as SAP GUI applications but are presented via a harmonized user experi- ence. This helps users access the system from a central SAP Fiori launchpad, enjoy the new UX, and avoid the need to log on to SAP GUI. It’s worth mentioning that SAP is replacing additional SAP GUI transactions with SAP Fiori apps in each SAP S/4HANA release. Deeply integrated in SAP Fiori’s design foundation are the following features:  A fresh, new, modern look and feel  Intelligent home pages directing the user’s focus to relevant areas  Digital assistant with fully conversational user experience  Active business situation handling, with explanations/insights and proposed actions  Dynamic content supporting intelligent apps with embedded artificial intelligence (AI)  Improved search previews, results pages, and visualizations  A central inbox integrated with the digital assistant As of SAP S/4HANA Cloud 2208, the Horizon theme builds out the SAP Fiori launchpad to provide better focus within the screen. The core elements of SAP Fiori launchpad contain spaces, to-dos, pages, apps, and insights. The My Home app replaces the My Home space. For example, in SAP Fiori, you can click a tile such as Workflow Inbox and enter the Approvals app (shown in Figure 17.1). Unlike previous workflow approval layouts, you only see the fundamentals: the request list and an expanded window showing the con- tent of a selected request. 17 Customizing the User Interface 664 Figure 17.1 Approvals App Approvals is quite straightforward from a UI perspective and doesn’t need a lot of bells and whistles. Either you approve something or you reject a request, perhaps communi- cating directly with the user during the process to further refine the order or under- stand a nuance. Beyond this, there need not be a slew of features. The app is in line with this thinking and with SAP Fiori’s approach and principles overall. There are three types of SAP Fiori apps:  Transactional apps, which provide task-based access like the ability to change/create documents and data, or entire processes in guided navigation  SAP Smart Business analytical apps, which display a visual overview of a dedicated topic for KPI-driven analysis  Fact sheet apps, which offer a view of essential object information and provide con- textual navigation between related objects Both SAP Smart Business analytical and fact sheet apps run on SAP HANA, while the SAP Fiori transactional apps can run on any supported database, including SAP HANA. All three types of apps utilize SAPUI5 and SAP Gateway. SAP Fiori Launchpad As of SAP S/4HANA 1610, SAP Fiori is the sole UI option for SAP S/4HANA. A user can update her profile and access her applications/notifications all via a single landing page called the SAP Fiori launchpad, as shown in Figure 17.2. By clicking the profile icon and shell header icons located at the top of the window, a user can navigate to his last activities in the system or to key notifications, as shown in Figure 17.3. The anchor bar at the top replaces the group menu options. © 665 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA Figure 17.2 SAP Fiori Header Icons and Anchor Bar Figure 17.3 Recent Activities in SAP Fiori Launchpad Front and center are the apps, which can be made available via tiles or as links. Color- coding and dynamic charts in the tiles are used to update the user about important issues without having to drill into specific areas. The search option shown in Figure 17.4 allows you to search across and within apps, including individual business objects, to find immediate answers. 17 Customizing the User Interface 666 Figure 17.4 SAP Fiori Search Bar If you need to drill into a business object or app, or track down a particular material and its usage in the system, you can do so directly from the search results, as shown in Fig- ure 17.5. Here, the user searched for the metal “titanium” and retrieved search results across the system where this metal is being procured and used. You also can enter edit mode to personalize groups, tiles, and link menus and to launch into other applications in SAPUI5, in Web Dynpro ABAP, in SAP GUI for HTML, or via URLs. You have to be on a device supporting these UIs for this launch to be successful, however. Figure 17.5 Search for “Titanium” across System © 667 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA The supported UI technologies include the following:  Unified rendering (Web Dynpro, ABAP/Java, HTML GUI, Business Server Pages [BSP], HTML Business for Java)  SAPUI5 (SAP Fiori, SAP Fiori launchpad)  WebClient UIF (SAP CRM)  SAP Business Client (for desktop and HTML) SAP Fiori supports the following platforms:  SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP  SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) These changes put all the core information and access at the user’s fingertips while leav- ing some “whitespace” free for a featureless desktop rather than overloading the layout with distractions and nonessential functionality. In the SAP Fiori approach, no general newsfeeds or bulletin boards are found, just the key areas relevant to the user’s role. SAP Fiori Design Concept Evolution SAP Fiori 3 continues to leverage the Belize theme with light and dark flavors to further refine the SAP Fiori visual language while offering a clean and consistent layout to con- vey content and clarity. SAP Fiori 2.0 addressed some of the shortcomings from 1.0, including standardizing screen elements, icons, and color, as well as unifying interac- tions and adopting application design. SAP Fiori 3 continues in this direction. SAP Fiori Architecture Before you begin implementation or configuration of SAP Fiori for SAP S/4HANA, it’s important to understand the underlying SAP Fiori architecture for the different edi- tions of SAP S/4HANA. There are differences between logging into SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP S/4HANA. In SAP S/4HANA Cloud, users log in via the service’s web dispatcher and, once authen- ticated, access the SAP Fiori UI. From there, the user can then access the business logic layer of SAP S/4HANA Cloud via SAP Fiori apps and the general UI. In an on-premise version of SAP S/4HANA, the user logs into the SAP S/4HANA fron- tend server either via a browser to access the web dispatcher and system hosted inter- nally or via an on-premise desktop/VPN, as per Figure 17.6. Cloud users go directly to SAP S/4HANA without a mediated connection as in the on-premise version. For mobile devices, SAP provides SAP Mobile Platform, which leverages the SAP Fiori frontend server in turn, as per Figure 17.6. From an architecture standpoint, the main difference between SAP S/4HANA Cloud and the on-premise version is the frontend server requirement. This is the SAP S/4HANA 17 Customizing the User Interface 668 view with the changed access pattern for the SAP HANA database. From a sizing perspec- tive, the approach stays the same; only the load pattern changes. The desktop’s path runs from the web dispatcher directly to the SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP backend, whereas the mobile devices run through the web dispatcher to the frontend server, and then onward to the SAP NetWeaver ABAP backend and SAP S/4HANA database. Figure 17.6 SAP Fiori Architecture: Overview As shown in Figure 17.7, the main technical components of SAP Fiori on SAP S/4HANA are the frontend server, including SAP Gateway; SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP, including an SAP Gateway add-on; the SAP HANA database; SAP Web Dispatcher; and SAP Mobile Platform. Figure 17.7 SAP Fiori on SAP S/4HANA Architecture: Simplified System View Tools On-premise Web SAP S/4HANA Cloud SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA business logic SAP Fiori Applications OData Services SAP Web IDE SAP Fiori User Interfaces SAP Crystal Reports Backend Services SAP Fiori Applications OData Services Mobile Services SAP Business Suite (ERP, SRM, …) SAP S/4HANA … Frontend Server SAP Mobile Platform for Mobile Devices SAP HANA SAP Frontend Server, includes SAP Gateway SAP Web Dispatcher NW ABAP SAP HANA Non-NW SAP NetWeaver ABAP, includes gateway add-on Change Any SAP database SAP Mobile Platform Analytical Transactional Analytical Transactional Analytical Any database © 669 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA SAP Mobile Start was introduced in August 2021 as a mobile app for iOS and Android integrated with SAP solutions, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP. The SAP Build Work Zone standard edition, SAP Alert Notification service for SAP BTP, and SAP BTP’s mobile services work together to enable websites and apps for mobile access, as in Fig- ure 17.8. Figure 17.8 SAP Start Mobile App From SAP S/4HANA, a user can access the SAP Fiori launchpad via a supported web browser and launch the following:  SAP Fiori apps  SAP GUI for HTML  Web Dynpro apps SAP Business Client Another way to support SAP Fiori is via SAP Business Client. This approach replaces the web browser with a dedicated UI called SAP Business Client. This provides more focused throughput on the transaction side, meaning faster speeds, and it’s sometimes 17 Customizing the User Interface 670 favored for desktop users performing specific transactions in the system for this rea- son. Future support is planned for a Windows SAP GUI in the SAP Business Client UI approach to SAP S/4HANA. The Windows SAP GUI in SAP Business Client version will initially come in the classic SAP GUI design, with the SAP Fiori theme planned for future releases of this approach. As of SAP Business Client 6.0, the ability to add system connections for SAP Fiori launchpad was introduced. Central Hub versus Embedded: Deploying SAP Gateway Further drilling into the general architecture of SAP Fiori for SAP S/4HANA, you can deploy SAP Gateway either in a separate, central hub or in an embedded fashion, as in Figure 17.9. Depending on your role in the project, you may or may not be tasked with deciding on the approach here, as it’s typically more of an IT decision. However, know- ing the trade-offs, even at a functional level, is helpful for understanding how your SAP Fiori environment works. Figure 17.9 outlines the components involved for SAP Fiori, principally the web server and the ABAP frontend and backend servers. Figure 17.9 Central Hub versus Embedded Deployment SAP Gateway The central hub approach is more typical in productive environments than the embed- ded deployment, though the embedded option is lightweight and allows for speedier setup of test environments. Key advantages of an embedded deployment are as fol- lows:  No additional SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP system needed; less TCO  Less runtime overhead, as well as no remote call  Direct access to metadata and business data  Later scale-out to central hub deployment possible Central Hub Deployment of SAP Gateway SAP Gateway Server SAP Fiori UI Add-Ons SAPUI5 SAP Gateway IW_BEP SAP Fiori Integration Add-Ons Embedded Deployment of SAP Gateway SAP Gateway Server SAPUI5 SAP Gateway IW_BEP SAP Fiori Integration Add-Ons SAP Fiori UI Add-Ons SAP S/4HANA SAP S/4HANA © 671 17.1 User Interface Options in SAP S/4HANA However, there are some points to consider for the embedded approach:  Innovation speed of SAP Fiori UI and backend must be synchronized  Update strategy must reflect dependencies between software components  SAP backend must fulfill minimum system requirements  Possible scale-up of SAP backend (resizing) Currently, the majority of organizations are on a central hub deployment, which has its own advantages and considerations. Regardless of the deployment approach for the SAP Fiori frontend server, SAP Fiori 3 is mandatory for all SAP Fiori apps on SAP S/4HANA 1610 and beyond, and these apps require an SAP database. Existing apps at this level and beyond currently run on the Belize theme. It’s also possible to run older apps on SAP Fiori 3 in their respective classic themes. Not all functionality may be accessible for older apps without adjustments.
sections.he:
גישות UI רבות בעבר יצרו cockpit מציף של בקרות, כפתורים, וידיות, שבלבל משתמשים. ‏SAP Fiori מדגיש אינטראקציה מבוססת-role תוך שמירת התאמה וגמישות. הדגשת הפשטות (במקום עומס תכונות) עוברת לעקרונות הליבה:
• **Role-based** — מעוצב עבורך, צרכיך, ואופן עבודתך
• **Adaptive** — מסתגל למגוון use cases ומכשירים
• **Coherent** — חוויה אחת זורמת ואינטואיטיבית
• **Simple** — כולל רק את הנחוץ
• **Delightful** — יוצר חיבור רגשי

**Overview:** ‏SAP Fiori מספק UX מבוסס-role ברמת-צרכן בכל קווי העסק. ‏SAP Fiori 3 הוא ההתפתחות העדכנית — עקביות, אינטליגנציה, ואינטגרציה. מספק look and feel מתואם בין מוצרים, מאפשר embedded machine learning ואוטומציה של משימות שגרתיות, ומפשט שילוב תוכן ממוצרים שונים. ‏SAP Fiori 3 מעשיר את ה-UX עם אפליקציות אינטואיטיביות הרצות על מובייל ומחשבים. אפליקציות Fiori ממקדות בפונקציות, משימות, ופעילויות מפתח. ‏overview pages מספקות KPIs חיים ו-action items (כולל רשימות contracts פגי-תוקף). אפליקציות Fiori מסווגות כ-transactional, ‏analytical, ו-object page. ‏transactional מריצות עסקאות; ‏object page מציגות master data ומסמכים; ‏analytical מנתחות נתונים חיים לתובנות מיידיות (וגם פעולה לפי תובנות). מידע מפורט — http://s-prs.co/500303.
‏SAP Fiori 3 מספק UX מתואם בכל יישומי SAP (כולל ענן). ה-visual theme בשם Quartz מגיע בגרסה בהירה וכהה. לחלק מ-SAP GUI transactions עדיין אין אפליקציות Fiori, אך הן זמינות ב-theme של Fiori לחוויה חלקה — רצות ב-backend כ-SAP GUI אך מוצגות ב-UX מתואם. מאפשר גישה מ-launchpad מרכזי ללא התחברות ל-SAP GUI. ‏SAP מחליפה SAP GUI transactions נוספות באפליקציות Fiori בכל גרסה.
תכונות המשובצות בעיצוב:
• look and feel חדש ומודרני
• דפי בית חכמים המכוונים את המיקוד לאזורים רלוונטיים
• digital assistant עם UX שיחתי מלא
• ‏active business situation handling עם הסברים/תובנות ופעולות מוצעות
• תוכן דינמי התומך באפליקציות חכמות עם AI משובץ
• previews, ‏results pages, ו-visualizations משופרים בחיפוש
• inbox מרכזי משולב עם ה-digital assistant
מ-S/4HANA Cloud 2208, ה-Horizon theme בונה את ה-launchpad למיקוד טוב יותר. אלמנטי הליבה של ה-launchpad: ‏spaces, ‏to-dos, ‏pages, ‏apps, ו-insights. ‏My Home מחליפה את ה-My Home space.
למשל, ניתן ללחוץ על tile כגון Workflow Inbox ולהיכנס ל-Approvals (Figure 17.1). בשונה מפריסות workflow קודמות, רואים רק את היסודות: רשימת הבקשות וחלון מורחב המציג את תוכן הבקשה הנבחרת. ‏Approvals פשוטה — או מאשרים או דוחים, אולי בתקשורת ישירה עם המשתמש לחידוד ההזמנה. מעבר לכך, אין צורך בשפע תכונות — בקנה אחד עם גישת Fiori.
שלושה סוגי אפליקציות Fiori:
• **Transactional apps** — גישה מבוססת-משימה (שינוי/יצירת מסמכים ונתונים, או תהליכים שלמים ב-guided navigation)
• **SAP Smart Business analytical apps** — סקירה ויזואלית של נושא ייעודי ל-KPI-driven analysis
• **Fact sheet apps** — תצוגת מידע object חיוני וניווט הקשרי בין objects קשורים
גם SAP Smart Business analytical וגם fact sheet רצות על SAP HANA, בעוד transactional יכולות לרוץ על כל מסד נתונים נתמך (כולל HANA). כל השלושה מנצלים SAPUI5 ו-SAP Gateway.

**SAP Fiori Launchpad:** מ-S/4HANA 1610, ‏SAP Fiori הוא אפשרות ה-UI היחידה ל-S/4HANA. המשתמש מעדכן פרופיל ונגיש ליישומים/התראות דרך landing page יחיד — ה-SAP Fiori launchpad (Figure 17.2). בלחיצה על אייקון הפרופיל ואייקוני ה-shell header למעלה, ניתן לנווט לפעילויות האחרונות או להתראות מפתח (Figure 17.3). ה-anchor bar למעלה מחליף את אפשרויות ה-group menu.
במרכז — האפליקציות, זמינות כ-tiles או links. ‏color-coding ותרשימים דינמיים ב-tiles מעדכנים על נושאים חשובים ללא קידוח. אפשרות החיפוש (Figure 17.4) מאפשרת חיפוש בין ובתוך אפליקציות (כולל business objects בודדים) לתשובות מיידיות. בקידוח ל-business object/material ושימושו (Figure 17.5) — למשל חיפוש המתכת "titanium" החזיר תוצאות היכן היא נרכשת ומשמשת. ניתן גם להיכנס ל-edit mode להתאמת groups, ‏tiles, ו-link menus ולהפעלת יישומים ב-SAPUI5, ‏Web Dynpro ABAP, ‏SAP GUI for HTML, או דרך URLs (נדרש מכשיר תומך).
טכנולוגיות UI נתמכות:
• ‏unified rendering (Web Dynpro, ‏ABAP/Java, ‏HTML GUI, ‏Business Server Pages [BSP], ‏HTML Business for Java)
• ‏SAPUI5 (SAP Fiori, ‏SAP Fiori launchpad)
• ‏WebClient UIF (SAP CRM)
• ‏SAP Business Client (לדסקטופ ו-HTML)
פלטפורמות נתמכות: ‏SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP ו-SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). השינויים מציבים את המידע והגישה הליבתיים בהישג-יד תוך השארת "whitespace" לדסקטופ נטול-תכונות במקום עומס. בגישת Fiori אין newsfeeds או bulletin boards כלליים — רק האזורים הרלוונטיים ל-role.

**SAP Fiori Design Concept Evolution:** ‏SAP Fiori 3 ממשיך למנף את ה-Belize theme (בהיר וכהה) לחידוד השפה הויזואלית תוך פריסה נקייה ועקבית. ‏SAP Fiori 2.0 טיפל בחסרונות מ-1.0 — תקנון אלמנטי מסך, אייקונים, וצבע, איחוד אינטראקציות, ואימוץ application design. ‏SAP Fiori 3 ממשיך בכיוון זה.

**SAP Fiori Architecture:** לפני הטמעה/תצורה, חשוב להבין את הארכיטקטורה למהדורות השונות. יש הבדלים בין התחברות ל-S/4HANA Cloud ל-S/4HANA. ב-Cloud, המשתמשים מתחברים דרך ה-web dispatcher של השירות, ולאחר אימות ניגשים ל-Fiori UI, ומשם לשכבת ה-business logic דרך אפליקציות Fiori וה-UI הכללי. ב-on-premise, המשתמש מתחבר ל-frontend server דרך browser (לגישה ל-web dispatcher ולמערכת מאוחסנת-פנימית) או דרך desktop/VPN on-premise (Figure 17.6). משתמשי ענן ניגשים ישירות ל-S/4HANA ללא חיבור מתווך.
למכשירים ניידים, ‏SAP מספקת SAP Mobile Platform הממנפת את ה-frontend server (Figure 17.6). מבחינת ארכיטקטורה, ההבדל העיקרי בין Cloud ל-on-premise הוא דרישת ה-frontend server. מבחינת sizing, הגישה זהה; רק דפוס העומס משתנה. נתיב הדסקטופ רץ מה-web dispatcher ישירות ל-SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP backend, בעוד מכשירים ניידים רצים דרך ה-web dispatcher ל-frontend server ומשם ל-backend ול-database.
הרכיבים הטכניים העיקריים של Fiori על S/4HANA (Figure 17.7): ה-frontend server (כולל SAP Gateway); ‏SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP (כולל SAP Gateway add-on); מסד הנתונים SAP HANA; ‏SAP Web Dispatcher; ו-SAP Mobile Platform.
‏SAP Mobile Start הוצגה באוגוסט 2021 כאפליקציית מובייל ל-iOS ו-Android המשולבת עם פתרונות SAP (כולל S/4HANA ו-SAP BTP). ‏SAP Build Work Zone standard edition, ‏SAP Alert Notification service for SAP BTP, ושירותי המובייל של SAP BTP מאפשרים יחד אתרים ואפליקציות לגישה ניידת (Figure 17.8). מ-S/4HANA, המשתמש נגיש ל-launchpad דרך browser נתמך ומפעיל: אפליקציות Fiori, ‏SAP GUI for HTML, ואפליקציות Web Dynpro.

**SAP Business Client:** דרך נוספת לתמיכה ב-Fiori — מחליף את ה-browser ב-UI ייעודי בשם SAP Business Client. מספק throughput ממוקד יותר בצד הטרנזקציה (מהירות גבוהה יותר), מועדף לעיתים למשתמשי דסקטופ. תמיכה עתידית מתוכננת ל-Windows SAP GUI בגישה זו (בתחילה בעיצוב SAP GUI הקלאסי, עם theme של Fiori בעתיד). מ-SAP Business Client 6.0, נוספה היכולת להוסיף system connections ל-launchpad.

**Central Hub מול Embedded — פריסת SAP Gateway:** ניתן לפרוס SAP Gateway ב-central hub נפרד או באופן embedded (Figure 17.9). לפי ה-role בפרויקט, ייתכן שלא תוטל עליכם ההחלטה (בד"כ החלטת IT), אך הבנת ה-trade-offs מועילה. ‏Figure 17.9 מתאר את הרכיבים — ‏web server וה-ABAP frontend ו-backend servers.
גישת ה-central hub נפוצה יותר בסביבות productive, אף שה-embedded קל-משקל ומאפשר הקמה מהירה של test environments. יתרונות embedded:
• אין צורך ב-SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP נוסף; ‏TCO נמוך יותר
• פחות runtime overhead, ואין remote call
• גישה ישירה ל-metadata ו-business data
• ‏scale-out מאוחר ל-central hub אפשרי
נקודות לשיקול ב-embedded:
• מהירות החדשנות של Fiori UI וה-backend חייבת להיות מסונכרנת
• אסטרטגיית העדכון חייבת לשקף תלויות בין רכיבי תוכנה
• ה-backend חייב לעמוד בדרישות מינימליות
• ‏scale-up אפשרי של ה-backend (resizing)
כיום, רוב הארגונים על central hub deployment. ללא קשר לגישת הפריסה, ‏SAP Fiori 3 חובה לכל אפליקציות Fiori ב-S/4HANA 1610 ומעלה, ודורש מסד נתונים SAP. אפליקציות קיימות ברמה זו רצות על ה-Belize theme. ניתן גם להריץ אפליקציות ישנות על Fiori 3 ב-themes הקלאסיים שלהן (ייתכן שלא כל הפונקציה נגישה ללא התאמות).

sections.title: SAP GUI
sections.en: 17.1.2 SAP GUI SAP GUI has underpinned previous versions of SAP ERP, spanning back decades now. The screenshot in Figure 17.10 may look very familiar to long-time SAP users, even though it’s a screenshot of an SAP GUI screen in SAP S/4HANA. Little has changed here, and the transaction code bar still remains in the upper-left-hand corner. Figure 17.10 SAP GUI Classic transactions in SAP, even if they retain essentially the same fields, receive an overhaul in SAP Fiori in terms of appearance. These transactions are usually a couple of layers deeper into the process, rather than on the opening page. A key one for SAP 17 Customizing the User Interface 672 S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement is the well-known Transaction ME21N for POs. This is now the “advanced” version for creating a PO in SAP S/4HANA (see Figure 17.11), in which, as discussed in Chapter 4, a user can create a framework order and other more involved types of purchase orders. Figure 17.11 Create Purchase Order—Advanced In this transaction, the fields are mostly the same as in an SAP ERP environment, but the look and feel has been updated to align with SAP Fiori principles and approaches. This is the general approach taken by SAP for all classic transactions remaining in SAP Fiori and SAP S/4HANA. In SAP S/4HANA, you can launch SAP GUI either via HTML or the SAP Business Client approach. There are limitations and advantages to both options. Despite some limita- tions, SAP GUI HTML is the recommended approach for SAP GUI running the Belize theme. The SAP GUI limitations on the HTML side are as follows:  Office integration is view-only  No bar chart (GANTT), net chart, and supply chain management planning grid con- trols  No new ABAP Editor control (ABAP development needs SAP GUI for Windows)  Limited support for client interaction (upload/download/execute/etc.), especially in new browsers  Limited keyboard navigation  Lower performance compared to SAP GUI for Windows However, HTML does support SAP Screen Personas features. SAP Screen Personas is the personalization framework integrated into SAP GUI and multiple operating systems © 673
sections.he:
‏SAP GUI עומד בבסיס גרסאות SAP ERP קודמות זה עשורים. ה-screenshot ב-Figure 17.10 עשוי להיראות מוכר מאוד, אף שזה מסך SAP GUI ב-S/4HANA. מעט השתנה, וה-transaction code bar עדיין בפינה השמאלית-עליונה.
‏transactions קלאסיות, גם אם שומרות על אותם שדות, מקבלות שיפוץ ב-Fiori מבחינת מראה. הן בד"כ שתי שכבות עמוק יותר בתהליך, ולא בעמוד הפתיחה. מפתח ל-S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement היא Transaction ME21N ל-POs — כעת הגרסה "advanced" ליצירת PO (Figure 17.11), שבה (פרק 4) ניתן ליצור framework order וסוגי POs מורכבים יותר. בה, השדות זהים ברובם לסביבת SAP ERP, אך ה-look and feel עודכן ליישור עם Fiori. זו הגישה הכללית לכל ה-transactions הקלאסיות שנותרו.
ב-S/4HANA, ניתן להפעיל SAP GUI דרך HTML או SAP Business Client. יש מגבלות ויתרונות לשתיהן. למרות מגבלות, ‏SAP GUI HTML הוא הגישה המומלצת ל-SAP GUI הרץ על ה-Belize theme. מגבלות SAP GUI HTML:
• אינטגרציית Office לקריאה-בלבד
• אין בקרות bar chart (GANTT), ‏net chart, ו-supply chain management planning grid
• אין new ABAP Editor control (פיתוח ABAP דורש SAP GUI for Windows)
• תמיכה מוגבלת באינטראקציית client (upload/download/execute וכו'), במיוחד ב-browsers חדשים
• ניווט מקלדת מוגבל
• ביצועים נמוכים יותר מ-SAP GUI for Windows
עם זאת, ‏HTML תומך בתכונות SAP Screen Personas — מסגרת ה-personalization המשולבת ב-SAP GUI ובמערכות הפעלה מרובות דרך גישתה מבוססת-browser. חוויית Belize theme מקורית זמינה מ-Windows 7.5 ו-SAP Business Client 6.5. שימוש ב-themes ישנים אפשרי אך אינו מומלץ, ולא כל התכונות החדשות יאופשרו.

sections.title: Configuring SAP Fiori
sections.en: 17.2 Configuring SAP Fiori via its browser-based approach. A native Belize theme experience is available for SAP GUI as of Windows 7.5 and SAP Business Client 6.5. As far as using older themes in SAP Fiori, although possible, it isn’t recommended, and not all the new features will be enabled using an older theme. 17.2 Configuring SAP Fiori This section provides a general overview of the installation of and required compo- nents for SAP Fiori. You should always check support.sap.com prior to installing an SAP system to obtain the latest installation guides and notes.
sections.he: הסעיף מספק סקירה כללית של ההתקנה והרכיבים הנדרשים ל-SAP Fiori. תמיד בדקו את support.sap.com לפני התקנת מערכת SAP לקבלת מדריכי ההתקנה וה-notes העדכניים.

sections.title: Installing SAP Fiori
sections.en: 17.2.1 Installing SAP Fiori To install SAP Fiori, the technical Basis team on your project will need to complete the following steps: 1. Install SAP NetWeaver 7.5x with the latest service pack stack. The supported data- bases are SAP HANA, SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (SAP ASE), and SAP MaxDB. 2. Follow the SAP S/4HANA SAP Fiori foundation configuration guides found at https:// rapid.sap.com/bp/ under SAP Best Practice for SAP S/4HANA  S/4HANA  UX Best Practice for SAP S/4HANA. 3. Generate and download the maintenance planner software, which enables planning all changes for your SAP landscape. For more information, see http://s-prs.co/ 500322. 4. Perform SAP Gateway basic configuration—that is, the baseline configuration of SAP Gateway. 5. Set up the trusted RFCs/system aliases/SAP Fiori launchpad initial configuration. These are your basic setup steps for enabling the system to communicate with other systems and be configured. Configure your RFCs, define the system alias, and com- plete baseline configuration for SAP Fiori launchpad. 6. Activate SICF services and OData services. In Transaction SICF, you can activate ser- vices and nodes for HTTP communication. Activating OData services allows your RESTful APIs to be extended to support custom needs. REST stands for representa- tional state transfer and relies on a stateless, client-server-based, and cacheable com- munication protocol, which typically leverages HTTP. 7. Create and maintain standard SAP Fiori roles. 8. Install and configure SAP Web Dispatcher. SAP Web Dispatcher is required for on- premise installations of SAP S/4HANA and functions as a broker between the user’s browser and the SAP S/4HANA system. 17 Customizing the User Interface 674 9. Activate Enterprise Search (fact sheet applications). SAP Fiori fact sheets provide overview information on a business object. By enabling search, you can identify related fact sheets while searching for an item, such as a material master. 10. Load search indexes. Indexes allow a search to run faster and more comprehen- sively. 11. Set up the SAP BW client on the SAP S/4HANA system for embedded analytics. 12. Activate the SAP Business Client/WebGUI for HTML/Web Dynpro applications on the backend system.
sections.he:
להתקנת SAP Fiori, צוות ה-Basis הטכני ישלים:
1. התקנת SAP NetWeaver 7.5x עם ה-service pack stack העדכני. מסדי נתונים נתמכים: ‏SAP HANA, ‏SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (SAP ASE), ו-SAP MaxDB.
2. מעקב אחר מדריכי תצורת ה-Fiori foundation ב-https://rapid.sap.com/bp/ תחת SAP Best Practice for SAP S/4HANA • S/4HANA • UX Best Practice for SAP S/4HANA.
3. יצירה והורדה של maintenance planner software (מאפשר תכנון כל השינויים בנוף). למידע — http://s-prs.co/500322.
4. ביצוע SAP Gateway basic configuration — התצורה הבסיסית.
5. הקמת trusted RFCs/system aliases/SAP Fiori launchpad initial configuration — צעדי ההקמה הבסיסיים לתקשורת עם מערכות אחרות. הגדירו RFCs, ‏system alias, והשלימו תצורת baseline ל-launchpad.
6. הפעלת SICF services ו-OData services. ב-Transaction SICF ניתן להפעיל services ו-nodes לתקשורת HTTP. הפעלת OData services מאפשרת הרחבת ה-RESTful APIs לצרכים מותאמים. ‏REST = representational state transfer, נשען על פרוטוקול stateless, ‏client-server, ו-cacheable (לרוב HTTP).
7. יצירה ותחזוקה של SAP Fiori roles תקניים.
8. התקנה ותצורה של SAP Web Dispatcher — נדרש להתקנות on-premise, מתפקד כ-broker בין ה-browser ל-S/4HANA.
9. הפעלת Enterprise Search (fact sheet applications). ‏fact sheets מספקות מידע סקירה על business object. הפעלת החיפוש מזהה fact sheets קשורים בחיפוש פריט (כגון material master).
10. טעינת search indexes — לחיפוש מהיר ומקיף יותר.
11. הקמת SAP BW client על S/4HANA ל-embedded analytics.
12. הפעלת SAP Business Client/WebGUI for HTML/Web Dynpro על ה-backend.

sections.title: Embedded and Central Hub Deployment for SAP Fiori
sections.en: 17.2.2 Embedded and Central Hub Deployment for SAP Fiori You then either configure a central hub or embedded deployment of SAP Fiori. The cen- tral hub and embedded options are the two main ways to set up the system, and each has advantages and concerns. In general, the central hub approach is used for larger production systems and systems required to handle large volumes of users, transac- tions, and queries. An embedded deployment approach is often used for development and functional testing systems, for which volume requirements are not as pro- nounced, and sometimes for more modest production systems supporting smaller organizations. Central hub installation means you install the frontend and backend components on different systems. A central hub deployment requires more effort to set up but allows you to separate your SAP Solution Manager installation from your SAP Fiori apps, mak- ing your apps available to business users without having to run SAP Solution Manager. This approach also allows you to consolidate your SAP Fiori apps into one launchpad, even when using multiple systems. You can perform the development either in the SAP Gateway system or directly in SAP S/4HANA. Developing directly in SAP S/4HANA allows you to reuse data easily because the data is in the system in which the develop- ment is taking place. Developing on SAP Gateway allows for a loosely coupled, nonin- vasive approach to development that can also fulfill security requirements because SAP Gateway can be placed in a separate area from the SAP S/4HANA system. An embedded approach doesn’t require an SAP Gateway system and therefore reduces setup and costs. Development is done directly in the SAP S/4HANA system, allowing for similar advantages as found in the central hub option for developing on SAP S/4HANA; that is, less intermediation between systems is required. Once you’ve installed the system with either the embedded or central hub option, you’re ready to install SAP Fiori apps.
sections.he:
ואז מגדירים central hub או embedded deployment. שתי הדרכים העיקריות, לכל אחת יתרונות וחששות. בכלל, ‏central hub משמש למערכות production גדולות ולמערכות הדורשות נפחים גדולים של משתמשים, עסקאות, ו-queries. ‏embedded משמש לרוב למערכות development ו-functional testing (דרישות נפח פחות בולטות), ולעיתים למערכות production צנועות לארגונים קטנים.
‏central hub installation = התקנת רכיבי ה-frontend וה-backend על מערכות שונות. דורש יותר מאמץ אך מאפשר להפריד את התקנת SAP Solution Manager מאפליקציות ה-Fiori — האפליקציות זמינות ל-business users ללא הרצת SAP Solution Manager. גם מאפשר לאחד אפליקציות Fiori ל-launchpad אחד, גם עם מערכות מרובות. הפיתוח ב-SAP Gateway או ישירות ב-S/4HANA. פיתוח ישירות ב-S/4HANA מאפשר שימוש-חוזר קל בנתונים (הנתונים במערכת הפיתוח). פיתוח על SAP Gateway מאפשר גישה loosely coupled ולא-חודרנית העונה גם על דרישות אבטחה (ניתן למקם את SAP Gateway באזור נפרד).
גישת embedded אינה דורשת SAP Gateway ולכן מפחיתה הקמה ועלויות. הפיתוח ישירות ב-S/4HANA, עם יתרונות דומים ל-central hub בפיתוח על S/4HANA (פחות תיווך). לאחר ההתקנה (embedded או central hub), מוכנים להתקין אפליקציות Fiori.

sections.title: SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library
sections.en: 17.2.3 SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library With SAP Fiori installed, go to www.sap.com/fiori-apps-library to discover, explore, and implement SAP Fiori apps. In the SAP Fiori apps reference library, you can search for © 675 17.2 Configuring SAP Fiori apps, obtain recommendations based on your user profile and transaction code usage, analyze an app both on a functional and technical level, and, finally, implement the app in your system. In the library, you can search for and filter apps by business area, prod- uct type, and technical specifications. Based on your backend transactions and installed software, the search functionality provides suitable app recommendations as well. You then can explore individual apps, reviewing app details and versions, and finally download the selected apps. Once downloaded, you can further review their ver- sions, prerequisites, and dependencies. To implement the selected SAP Fiori apps, you integrate these apps with the maintenance planner, SAP Solution Manager’s cloud- based interface for planning all changes in your system landscape. Finally, you can export SAP Fiori configuration steps to task lists for automatic configuration. Implementing Procurement-Specific SAP Fiori Apps Let’s now explore the process of implementing an app from the SAP Fiori app library. For procurement-specific apps, you can search for and filter over 800 procurement apps (and growing) for SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement, as shown in Figure 17.12. All told, there are over 16,000 apps available for SAP S/4HANA! Figure 17.12 SAP Fiori App Library: Procurement Apps 17 Customizing the User Interface 676 One popular app for procurement is the Create Purchase Requisition—New app (see Figure 17.13). Let’s walk through how to install or evaluate this app. Figure 17.13 Create Purchase Requisition—New App To begin, select whether the system for the installation is in the cloud (SAP S/4HANA Cloud) or on premise (SAP S/4HANA), as shown in Figure 17.14. Figure 17.14 Installation System for App Once you’ve selected your system, you’ll need to verify whether your system can sup- port this app. Under Implementation Information, you can select your desired SAP S/4HANA version and access all of the implementation information available to install and use this app in your system, as shown in Figure 17.15. © 677 17.2 Configuring SAP Fiori Figure 17.15 Create Purchase Requisition—New: Implementation Information The Installation section reviews the required components for this app and reiterates the guidance for the using maintenance planner via SAP Solution Manager to deter- mine whether your system landscape will support the app, as shown in Figure 17.16. In the Configuration section, each app may have different areas requiring configura- tion. For the Create Purchase Requisitions app, ICF nodes, OData services, target map- ping, a business catalog, a group, a role, and search connectors all must be activated. Figure 17.16 Create Purchase Requisitions—New: Implementation in SAP S/4HANA Cloud 17 Customizing the User Interface 678 Upon completing the configuration, you can review the Extensibility section to iden- tify areas of the app that are extensible, the Support section to determine areas to ref- erence for support, and the Related Apps section to see groups of apps with similar functionality if required. Unlike the SAP Fiori settings and the SAP CoPilot features, to which every user may have access, very few users will have authorization to install and/or configure addi- tional apps in the system. The installation of apps is usually managed by a core system team in coordination with technical resources and a Basis team. Each installation, depending on the app, may vary in its steps and areas of review. The SAP Fiori apps ref- erence library also provides a recommendation functionality to aid in identifying new relevant apps for your user community, as discussed in the following section. Recommendations in SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library Search You can obtain app recommendations based on your system usage, which allows for further apps to be proposed. The recommendations are driven in part by the transac- tion codes you currently use in the backend system, highlighting the applicability as shown in Figure 17.17. Here, the search has yielded several relevant results, but from a system-readiness standpoint, only some of the required components for these recom- mended apps have been installed. Figure 17.17 SAP Fiori Apps Reference Library Recommendations: Sample Analysis To get recommendations, you first select your profile. You can then upload profiles via CSV files to tune the search recommendations still further. © 679
